summary.zh: 全國首創旅館服務與管理專業學系（85 年 3 月 1 日正式開課，創校四科之一）；截至 115 學年度設日間部四技 12 班、進修部四技 3 班（在學學生 486 人），並以「智慧旅館科技 × 奢華體驗管理」雙軸並進領航高餐旅宿教育。
summary.en: Taiwan's first department dedicated to hotel service and management (founded 1995/1996 as one of NKUHT's four founding departments), advancing a dual-axis model of Smart Hospitality Technology and Luxury Experience Management.

facts.zh: 系辦位於高雄市小港區松和路一號，第一教學大樓(F棟)1樓
facts.en: Office: No. 1, Songhe Rd., Xiaogang, Kaohsiung — Teaching Building I (Bldg F), 1F

plain.en: Address, phone and fax as posted on the official home page; use these for department enquiries.

facts.zh: 民國84年7月1日奉教育部核定成立旅館管理科，85年3月1日正式開課
facts.en: Approved as a hotel management junior-college program on 1 July 1995; classes began 1 March 1996

facts.zh: 本系（科）為全國首創，以實用至上為理念，結合三明治教學法、勞作教育等新學制
facts.en: The nation's first such program, practice-first, combining sandwich teaching and labor education

facts.zh: 雙軸發展關鍵節點：108 年推動教育部紫領計畫與群賢會館智慧旅宿修繕（智慧旅館科技軸）；113 年與文華東方、W 飯店、嘉佩樂簽署育才扎根計畫（奢華體驗管理軸）；114 年 3 月啟用「餐旅數位智慧服務與創新基地」。
facts.en: Dual-Axis Milestones: 2019 MOE Purple-Collar Project & Qunxian AIoT renovation (Smart Tech Axis); 2024 Luxury Brand Talent Incubation with Mandarin Oriental, W Taipei & Capella (Luxury Axis); March 2025 Digital Service & Innovation Base.

plain.zh: 本系為全國首創之旅館服務與管理專業學系（創校四科之一，85 年 3 月 1 日正式開課），近以 108 年教育部紫領計畫開啟「智慧旅館科技軸」、113 年國際奢華品牌育才扎根開啟「奢華體驗管理軸」，114 年 3 月啟用 D 棟 8 樓餐旅數位智慧服務與創新基地。
plain.en: Taiwan's first hotel management department (one of NKUHT's four founding departments in 1995/1996), pioneering the Smart Hospitality Tech axis (since 2019) and Luxury Experience Management axis (since 2024).

facts.en: Evening division Feb 2000; upgraded to a two-year program Aug 2000; four-year program added 2002

facts.zh: 96年招收越南生專班、97年招收產學攜手專班，99年8月升格國立高雄餐旅大學
facts.en: Vietnamese-student class 2007, industry-academia class 2008; university status (NKUHT) Aug 2010

facts.zh: 截至 115 學年度計有日間部四技 12 班、進修部四技 3 班（共 15 班，在學學生約 486 人、專任與專案教師 10 位、業界兼任教師 15 位）；115 學年度起停招進修部四技，資源集中深化日間部四技教學。
facts.en: As of AY 115, hosts 12 daytime and 3 continuing-education 4-year classes (~486 students, 10 full-time/project faculty, 15 industry adjuncts), focusing resources on the daytime 4-year program.

plain.zh: 本系自 84 年設科、89 年升格旅館管理系、91 年招收日間部四技、99 年改名國立高雄餐旅大學；截至 115 學年度設日間部四技 12 班、進修部四技 3 班（在學學生約 486 人），並自 115 學年度起將資源全面集中於日間部四技菁英培育。
plain.en: Expanded from a junior college department (1995) to a 4-year Bachelor program (2002) and university (2010); as of AY 115, comprises 15 classes (~486 students) with resources focused on the 4-year daytime program.

facts.zh: 每週安排導師時間、週會時間，並召開導師會議
facts.en: Weekly mentor hours and assemblies; regular mentor meetings

facts.zh: 配合校方勞作教育制度，落實校園環境清潔工作態度；並積極規劃學生就業輔導
facts.en: Following the university's labor-education system for campus cleaning; active career guidance planning

plain.zh: 官網「系務工作」明列導師時間、週會與勞作教育，並召開系務會議、教學研討會與導師會議，使系務運作制度化。
plain.en: Department affairs list mentor hours, assemblies and labor education, plus affairs, teaching and mentor meetings.

facts.zh: 設主任一人推動系行政業務，另置組員一人協助辦理行政工作
facts.en: A chair leads department administration, assisted by one staff member

facts.zh: 新進教師聘任依公開、公正原則，經系教評初審、院教評複審及校教評通過
facts.en: New faculty hiring is open and fair: department review, college review, then university approval

facts.zh: 112–114 學年度六學期共召開系務會議 29 次、課程委員會 35 次、教師評審委員會 39 次、校外實習輔導會議 25 次、自我評鑑會議 6 次；每年 4 月依 PDCA 循環整體檢討課程，並實施導師與 Office Hour 雙軌輔導。
facts.en: Convened 29 Department Affairs, 35 Curriculum, 39 Faculty Evaluation, 25 Internship, and 6 Self-Evaluation meetings across AY 112–114, conducting annual April PDCA curriculum reviews.

plain.zh: 本系以「系務會議、課程委員會（納入學生與業界代表）、教師評審委員會、校外實習輔導小組、自我評鑑會議」五類會議落實制度化決策與 PDCA 品保循環（112–114 學年度合計召開 134 次會議）。
plain.en: Operates through five institutionalized committees (Department Affairs, Curriculum with student/industry reps, Faculty Evaluation, Internship Guidance, and Self-Evaluation), convening 134 meetings across AY 112–114.

referenceSummary.zh:
民國84年7月1日奉教育部核定成立旅館管理科，85年3月1日正式開課，為全國首創；系辦位於第一教學大樓(F棟)1樓。
以實用至上為理念，結合三明治教學法、勞作教育等新學制，為旅館事業中高階人才培養貢獻心力。
referenceSummary.en:
Approved by the Ministry of Education on 1 July 1995 and opened on 1 March 1996 as the nation's first such program; the office is on 1F of Teaching Building I (Bldg F).
Practice first: combining new systems such as sandwich teaching and labor education to develop mid- to senior-level hotel talent.

vision.zh: 以實用至上為理念，結合三明治教學法、勞作教育等新學制，為旅館事業中高階人才培養貢獻心力。
vision.en: Practice first: combining new systems such as sandwich teaching and labor education to develop mid- to senior-level hotel talent.

summary.zh: 承接校級「人文化、專業化、企業化、國際化」治校理念，以「專業能力、實務素養、數位應用、國際競爭力」四大教育目標要素對應 113 版課程地圖 A–H 八大核心能力指標，強化實作力、就業力與競爭力。
summary.en: Guided by NKUHT's four institutional pillars, mapping four educational elements (Professional Competence, Practical Ethos, Digital Application, Global Competitiveness) to 8 Core Competencies (A–H).

facts.zh: 開設旅館管理方面之實用課程，研擬旅館相關學科教材，充實教學內容及設備
facts.en: Practical hotel management courses, in-house teaching materials, enriched content and equipment

facts.zh: 延攬具有實務經驗之優良師資，注重教學方法，提升教學實效
facts.en: Recruiting teachers with industry experience and emphasizing effective teaching methods

plain.zh: 一切教學措施遵照大學法等相關規定，並依本系特殊屬性擬定具前瞻性、實務性及國際性之教學工作計畫。
plain.en: All teaching follows the University Act and related rules, with plans tailored to the department's character.

facts.zh: 教學大綱先請相關學者、業界專家共同研討後定案，由任課教師編撰實用教材
facts.en: Syllabi are finalized with scholars and industry experts; teachers write practical materials

facts.zh: 教學著重老師示範、學生親自操作並錄影留存，作為檢討與改進參考
facts.en: Teacher demonstration and hands-on student practice, video-recorded for review

plain.zh: 輔以期刊、講座及校外參訪，採觀摩式與討論式教學；以書寫開創性心得報告取代傳統作業，激發「找資料、創新意」潛能。
plain.en: Supplemented by journals, talks and visits; observation and discussion methods; reflective reports replace routine homework.

name.zh: 總培育目標與專業能力目標

facts.zh: 總培育目標：順應世界觀光潮流，配合國家餐旅服務業發展及業界人才需求
facts.en: Overall goal: follow global tourism trends and meet national hospitality growth and talent needs

facts.zh: 專業能力目標：培養具國際觀且兼具專業知識、技能、服務道德及敬業樂群的中階旅館管理專業幹部人才
facts.en: Professional goal: internationally minded mid-level hotel managers with knowledge, skills, ethics and team spirit

facts.zh: 教育目標四要素與八大核心能力（113 版課程地圖）：A 社會基礎知識能力、B 餐旅基礎知識能力、C 旅館實務管理能力、D 旅館餐飲服務能力、E 旅館公關管理能力、F 旅館危機處理能力、G 數位資訊應用能力（定位於營運現場數據判讀與決策支援）、H 旅館行政管理能力。
facts.en: 8 Core Competencies (113 Curriculum Map): A. Social Foundation, B. Hospitality Foundation, C. Hotel Operations Management, D. Hotel F&B Service, E. Public Relations, F. Crisis Management, G. Digital & IT Application, H. Hotel Administration.

plain.zh: 承接校級「人文化、專業化、企業化、國際化」治校理念，落實「務實致用，學用合一」，以「專業能力、實務素養、數位應用、國際競爭力」四大要素轉化為實作力、就業力與競爭力，並對應 113 版課程地圖 A～H 八大核心能力。
plain.en: Integrates NKUHT's four institutional ideals into four educational elements—Professional Competence, Practical Ethos, Digital Application, and Global Competitiveness—mapped to 8 Core Competencies (A–H).

facts.zh: 兼具旅館專業與管理知識之整合；理論與實務並重；熟悉現代旅館內之軟硬體
facts.en: Integrate hotel expertise with management; balance theory and practice; know modern hotel hardware and software

facts.zh: 精通外國語言；落實職業道德與服務精神
facts.en: Master foreign languages; practice professional ethics and service spirit

facts.zh: 雙軸特色定位：第一軸「智慧旅館科技」（紫領計畫 → 智能服務中心 → 群賢智慧客房 → 餐旅數位智慧服務與創新基地）；第二軸「奢華體驗管理」（國際奢華品牌育才扎根 → 企業學苑專班 → 8 門奢華體驗管理微學分），兩軸交會於「菁英實習 3.0」。
facts.en: Dual-Axis Positioning: Axis 1 Smart Hospitality Tech (Smart Service Lab, AIoT guestrooms, Digital Innovation Base) × Axis 2 Luxury Experience Management (Luxury Brand Incubation & 8 micro-credit courses), converging in Elite Internship 3.0.

plain.zh: 官網五項特色目標結合本系「智慧旅館科技 × 奢華體驗管理」雙軸定位：一方面強化 AIoT、PMS 與大數據決策應用，另一方面深化國際奢華酒店顧客體驗設計與情緒價值創造。
plain.en: Combines the five official program goals with a Dual-Axis Positioning: Smart Hospitality Technology (PMS, AIoT, data analytics) and Luxury Experience Management (guest experience design & emotional value).

referenceSummary.zh:
培育具有國際觀且兼具專業知識、技能、服務道德及敬業樂群之中級旅館專業幹部人才。
擬定具有前瞻性、實務性及國際性之教學工作計畫，務期各項工作均能落實而有良好績效。
referenceSummary.en:
Developing internationally minded mid-level hotel professionals with knowledge, skills, service ethics and team spirit.
Forward-looking, practical and international teaching plans, carried out with good results.

vision.zh: 擬定具有前瞻性、實務性及國際性之教學工作計畫，務期各項工作均能落實而有良好績效。
vision.en: Forward-looking, practical and international teaching plans, carried out with good results.

name.zh: 三明治教學與實習動線

summary.zh: 串聯「大一二職涯探索與校內實作 → 大三一年校外實習跨部門輪調 → 大四理論整合與儲備主管培訓 → 畢業儲備幹部直通」四年品牌共育路徑，結合神秘客試住檢核與國內外移地教學。
summary.en: Connects a 4-year brand co-cultivation pathway from Years 1–2 exploration and Mystery Guest practicum to Year 3 full-year internship rotation, Year 4 MT training, and direct management fast-track upon graduation.

facts.zh: 官網「課程地圖」提供旅館管理系課程地圖-113與課程地圖-112
facts.en: The Curriculum Map page offers the department's maps for AY113 and AY112

facts.zh: 課程標準表依第一至第四學年及上下學期，列出各科目學分與時數
facts.en: The curriculum standard lists credits and hours by year (1–4) and semester

facts.zh: 國際品牌四年職涯培育路徑：大一、大二職涯探索與品牌說明會 → 大三一年校外實習與跨部門輪調 → 大四潛力學生銜接儲備主管（MT）培訓 → 畢業透過儲備幹部直通機制銜接月薪 4 萬元以上職涯起點。
facts.en: 4-Year Brand Career Pathway: Years 1–2 career exploration & brand briefings → Year 3 full-year internship & cross-division rotation → Year 4 Management Trainee (MT) track → Graduation fast-track to NT$40,000+/mo management roles.

plain.zh: 課程地圖（113 版）已完成系、院、校三級課程委員會審議，將 A～H 八大核心能力與四年三明治學習時程（大一二職涯探索、大三一年校外實習跨部門輪調、大四儲備主管培訓、畢業儲備幹部直通）緊密串聯。
plain.en: The 113 Curriculum Map (approved through 3-tier review) links Core Competencies A–H with the 4-year Sandwich pathway from foundational practice to Year 3 internships and Year 4 Management Trainee preparation.

facts.zh: 系務工作安排學生校外參觀及教學活動，並聘請產、官、學專家蒞系專題演講
facts.en: The department arranges field visits and invites industry, government and academic speakers

facts.zh: 系訂選修列有海外參訪(一)(二)各1學分，修(二)須先修畢(一)
facts.en: Electives include Field Study (I) and (II), 1 credit each; (II) requires (I)

facts.zh: 教師與學生實地觀摩涵蓋台北文華東方酒店、新竹豐邑喜來登大飯店、桃園大溪笠復威斯汀度假酒店、雲品溫泉酒店、綠生農場及高雄在地星級酒店，深化品牌文化與 ESG 永續實務體驗。
facts.en: Faculty and student field visits span Mandarin Oriental Taipei, Sheraton Hsinchu, The Westin Tashee Resort, Fleur de Chine Sun Moon Lake, eco-farms, and Kaohsiung star-rated hotels.

plain.zh: 除海外參訪選修課程外，本系定期辦理國際觀光酒店品牌永續知能研習、ESG 永續觀摩與在地星級酒店移地教學，參訪前規劃學習任務、參訪後撰寫反思報告。
plain.en: Alongside overseas study-visit courses, conducts ESG sustainability field visits and off-campus learning at international luxury hotels, pairing pre-visit tasks with post-visit reflective reports.

name.zh: 三明治教學法：理論與實務

facts.zh: 藉由校內學習專業理論及校外赴旅館產業實習，預期理論與實際兼具
facts.en: Campus theory and off-campus hotel internships, combining theory with practice

facts.zh: 建構「產業學院」為本系發展特色目標，與旅館產業界密切合作與深耕
facts.en: Building an 'industry college' through close, deep cooperation with the hotel industry

plain.zh: 三明治教學法是官網沿革所載、本系創立時結合的突破性新學制之一。
plain.en: Sandwich teaching is one of the new systems the department adopted at its founding, per the official history.

facts.zh: 115學年度系訂必修列有校內實習(一)；校內實習(三)標註「擬刪除」
facts.en: AY115 required courses list On-Campus Internship (I); (III) is marked 'to be removed'

facts.zh: 校內實習(二)標註「調整為系訂選修」，並列於系訂選修欄
facts.en: On-Campus Internship (II) is marked 'moved to department elective'

facts.zh: S3「實習旅館神秘客培訓與反饋」：學生經課堂培訓與儀器演練後，由四班輪流試住群賢會館檢核品質，回收 92 份評分表、提出 52 項改善建議（硬體 22 項逐項修復、服務 30 項納入教材與實習改善重點）。
facts.en: S3 Mystery Guest Program: Four classes rotated through trial stays at Qunxian Hotel, completing 92 evaluation forms and 52 actionable improvements (22 hardware fixes and 30 service cases integrated into teaching materials).

plain.zh: 校內實習採大四帶領大一、大二「大手攜小手」實境傳承，結合中程發展計畫 S3「實習旅館神秘客培訓與反饋」檢核客房品質；自 113-2 學期起以學生學習權益為優先，改採志願服務學習、社群貼文產製與反思報告。
plain.en: On-campus practicum pairs seniors mentoring freshmen/sophomores with S3 Mystery Guest quality audits at Qunxian Practicum Hotel, prioritizing student learning rights through voluntary service-learning and digital media reporting.

name.zh: 三合一策略：實習到就業

facts.zh: 本系積極推動「三合一策略」，與業界建立良性的密切互動關係
facts.en: The department promotes a 'three-in-one strategy' of close ties with industry

facts.zh: 學生得以充分獲得校外實習機會、汲取實務經驗，畢業後即可順利就業
facts.en: Students gain ample internship opportunities and experience, easing employment after graduation

plain.zh: 官網「行政與系務」所列策略：透過與業界的密切互動，讓校外實習銜接畢業後就業。
plain.en: A strategy listed under Administration: close industry ties link internships with jobs after graduation.

name.zh: 第三學年：校外實習(一)(二)

facts.zh: 115學年度課程標準表將校外實習(一)(二)列為系訂必修，各10學分
facts.en: The AY115 curriculum lists Internship (I) and (II) as required, 10 credits each

facts.zh: 校外實習成績需提據廠商實習證明並檢附實習成果，作為成績評定標準
facts.en: Grades require the employer's internship certificate plus internship outcomes

label.zh: 第三學年（115學年度課程標準表）

plain.zh: 第三學年系訂必修小計上下學期各10學分，即校外實習(一)(二)；評分方式載於課程標準表備註。
plain.en: Year 3 required subtotal is 10 credits per semester — Internship (I) and (II); grading is in the notes.

facts.zh: 為達「校外實習乃校內學習之延伸」，本系教師均定期赴學生實習場所訪視
facts.en: Teachers regularly visit internship sites, as internship extends campus learning

facts.zh: 課程規劃鼓勵學生至國際觀光旅館與海外實習以拓展視野
facts.en: The curriculum plan encourages internships at international tourist hotels and overseas

plain.zh: 教師訪視時並與旅館業界保持密切連繫，讓校外實習與校內學習相互銜接。
plain.en: During visits teachers keep close contact with hotels, linking internship and campus learning.

referenceSummary.zh:
藉由校內學習專業理論及校外赴旅館產業實習，預期理論與實際兼具；115學年度課程標準表列校外實習(一)(二)各10學分。
達到「校外實習乃校內學習之延伸」的教育功能，讓學生汲取實務經驗，畢業後即可順利就業。
referenceSummary.en:
Campus theory plus off-campus hotel internships; the AY115 curriculum lists Internship (I) and (II) at 10 credits each.
Internship as an extension of campus learning, giving students practical experience for smooth employment.

vision.zh: 達到「校外實習乃校內學習之延伸」的教育功能，讓學生汲取實務經驗，畢業後即可順利就業。
vision.en: Internship as an extension of campus learning, giving students practical experience for smooth employment.

summary.zh: 依系、院、校三級課程委員會與 PDCA 品保循環滾動修訂，112–114 學年累計辦理 158 次業界專家協同教學（67 位業師），並開設 8 門「奢華體驗管理微學分」與智慧餐旅系列課程。
summary.en: Refined via PDCA quality assurance and 3-tier curriculum committees, featuring 158 industry co-teaching sessions (67 executives) and 8 Luxury Experience Management micro-credit courses.

facts.zh: 畢業128學分，含校訂必修36、院訂必修12、系訂必修55、系訂選修25學分
facts.en: 128 credits: 36 university, 12 college, 55 department required, 25 department elective

facts.zh: 跨系選修（含跨校、跨領域微學分課程）至多承認6學分
facts.en: Cross-department electives (incl. cross-school and micro-credits) count up to 6 credits

plain.zh: 課程標準表備註並載明：每學期修課及互跨選修依本校選課辦法辦理，畢業前須符合本系畢業條件標準。
plain.en: Notes: semester loads follow course-selection rules, and the department's graduation requirements must be met.

facts.zh: 課程分為實務技能與管理能力之定位，涵蓋資訊科技、數位行銷與大數據分析
facts.en: Courses target practical skills and management, covering IT, digital marketing and big data

facts.zh: 邀請業界專家學者蒞校進行雙師課程及各式講座，並參與課程規劃會議提供建言
facts.en: Industry experts co-teach, give talks and advise in curriculum planning meetings

facts.zh: 112–114 學年協同教學業師來自台北文華東方、台北 W 飯店、遠東香格里拉、勤美洲際、新竹喜來登、漢來、台北君悅、國泰萬怡、寒舍、萬楓、大倉久和與精誠資訊等指標企業（如 W 飯店主管於旅館資產管理系統課程親授 OPERA PMS）。
facts.en: Co-teaching executives represent Mandarin Oriental Taipei, W Taipei, Far Eastern Shangri-La, InterContinental Taichung, Sheraton Hsinchu, Grand Hi-Lai, Grand Hyatt Taipei, Courtyard Taipei Downtown, Humble House, and Systex.

plain.zh: 112–114 學年度累計辦理 158 次業界專家協同教學（涵蓋 61 門次課程、67 位不重複業界專家、各學期累計 115 人次），邀請國際奢華酒店與科技企業主管親授營運、OPERA PMS、人資、財務與禮賓實務。
plain.en: Delivered 158 industry co-teaching sessions across 61 courses with 67 hospitality & tech executives (115 cumulative appointments) during AY 112–114, covering hotel operations, OPERA PMS, HR, finance, and concierge.

facts.zh: 系訂必修列有旅館會計學（3學分）與旅館財務管理（2學分）
facts.en: Required: Hospitality Accounting (3 cr) and Hotel Financial Management (2 cr)

facts.zh: 旅館人力資源管理、旅館行銷管理同為系訂必修，各2學分
facts.en: Hotel Human Resources Management and Hotel Marketing Management are required, 2 cr each

plain.zh: 系訂選修另列有旅館採購管理與成本控制（2學分）。
plain.en: Hotel Purchasing Management and Cost Control (2 cr) is a department elective.

facts.zh: 院訂必修12學分：餐旅管理、管理學、服務設計與創新、服務管理，各3學分
facts.en: College required, 12 cr: Hospitality Management, Management, Service Design & Innovation, Service Management (3 each)

facts.zh: 院訂選修：雲端商業軟體應用、數位多媒體設計實務、餐旅自媒體行銷，各2學分
facts.en: College electives: Cloud Business Software, Digital Multimedia Design, Hospitality Self-Media Marketing (2 each)

plain.zh: 院訂選修每門2學分2時數，同學可對照課程標準表規劃修課。
plain.en: Each college elective is 2 credits / 2 hours; plan with the curriculum table.

name.zh: 系訂必修：客務、房務、餐飲

facts.zh: 客務實務、房務實務與管理、餐飲實務皆為系訂必修，各3學分
facts.en: Front Office Operations, Housekeeping Operation & Management, F&B Service: required, 3 cr each

facts.zh: 房務實務與管理、餐飲實務標註＊，得依班級數及實際需求彈性調整開課學期
facts.en: Housekeeping and F&B are starred: the semester may be adjusted by class size and needs

plain.zh: 三門實務課對應旅館客務、房務與餐飲作業，皆列於115學年度系訂必修。
plain.en: Three hands-on courses for front office, housekeeping and F&B, all required in AY115.

name.zh: 系訂選修：旅館管理進階

facts.zh: 系訂選修列有旅館籌備與規劃、旅館督導實務、旅館管理個案探討，各2學分
facts.en: Electives: Hotel Pre-Opening, Supervision in the Hotel Industry, Hotel Case Studies (2 cr each)

facts.zh: 另有宴會管理、管家服務、服務中心作業實務等選修，各2學分
facts.en: Also Banquet Management, Butler Service, Concierge Operation (2 cr each)

facts.zh: 8 門「奢華體驗管理微學分」（113-2 至 114-2）：①人格特質剖析與旅館職業、②行為面談解析及實務應用、③國際連鎖品牌導論及領導統御、④奢華酒店管家服務、⑤旅館禮賓諮詢技巧（與 W 飯店合開）、⑥客房向上銷售技巧（與 W 飯店合開）、⑦實習職前準備與職場認知、⑧國際品牌連鎖旅館發展史。
facts.en: 8 Luxury Experience Management Micro-Credits: Personality & Hospitality Careers, Behavioral Interviewing, International Brand Leadership, Luxury Butler Service, Concierge Skills (with W Taipei), Room Upselling (with W Taipei), Pre-Internship Readiness, and Brand Chain History.

plain.zh: 除正式選修外，本系將「國際奢華酒店企業學苑專班」經驗轉化為 8 門已完成三級三審之「奢華體驗管理微學分」課程，與台北 W 飯店等高階主管共同規劃，核心聚焦於「顧客體驗設計與情緒價值創造」。
plain.en: In addition to regular electives, offers 8 approved Luxury Experience Management micro-credit courses co-designed with executives from W Taipei and luxury hotel groups, focusing on guest experience design and emotional value.

name.zh: 系訂選修：觀光與服務素養

facts.zh: 觀光學、人際關係與溝通技巧、國際禮儀、跨文化服務與管理，各2學分
facts.en: Tourism Management, Human Relations & Communication, International Etiquette, Cross-cultural Service (2 each)

facts.zh: 酒類專業知識、旅館客房銷售技能實務、旅館業訓練技能實務，各2學分
facts.en: Wines Knowledge, Hotel Upselling Technique, Coaching Techniques for Hotel Industry (2 each)

plain.zh: 以上皆為115學年度課程標準表所列系訂選修科目。
plain.en: All are department electives in the AY115 curriculum standard.

facts.zh: 旅館安全與衛生管理為系訂必修，2學分
facts.en: Hotel Security & Sanitation Management is required, 2 credits

facts.zh: 餐旅法規列於系訂選修，2學分
facts.en: Hospitality and Tourism Law is a department elective, 2 credits

plain.zh: 安全衛生與法規相關課程皆列於115學年度課程標準表。
plain.en: Both are listed in the AY115 curriculum standard.

facts.zh: 日間部四年制98至108學年度畢業學分數為132學分
facts.en: Day program AY98–108: 132 graduation credits

facts.zh: 109學年度起調整為128學分；98學年度院訂必修為0，99-100學年度起為12學分
facts.en: 128 credits from AY109; college required was 0 in AY98 and 12 from AY99–100

label.zh: 依官網各學年度課程標準表

plain.zh: 各學年度課程標準表PDF皆可於官網「課程標準表」下載，備註欄載有教務會議通過紀錄。
plain.en: Each year's PDF is on the Curriculum Standards page; remarks note academic-affairs approvals.

who.zh: 依入學年度查詢的同學

name.zh: 進修部與其他學制課程

facts.zh: 進修部四年制113、114學年度畢業128學分，校訂必修38、院訂必修12學分
facts.en: Evening 4-year, AY113–114: 128 credits, 38 university and 12 college required

facts.zh: 進修部二年制畢業72學分；產業攜手合作專班四年制（106學年度）畢業128學分
facts.en: Evening 2-year: 72 credits; industry-academia 4-year class (AY106): 128 credits

label.zh: 依官網各學年度課程標準表

plain.zh: 官網「課程標準表」頁面依學制分列日間部、進修部四年制、大陸地區學生、產業攜手合作專班與進修部二年制課程標準表。
plain.en: The page lists day, evening 4-year, mainland-student, industry-academia and evening 2-year tables.

referenceSummary.zh:
115學年度日間部四年制畢業學分128學分：校訂必修36、院訂必修12、系訂必修55、系訂選修25學分。
配合技職教育「務實致用」方向，學術理論與實務能力並行，課程涵蓋資訊科技、數位行銷與大數據分析。
referenceSummary.en:
AY115 day program: 128 credits — 36 university, 12 college, 55 department required, 25 department elective.
Practical, applied vocational education: theory and practice together, covering IT, digital marketing and big data.

vision.zh: 配合技職教育「務實致用」方向，學術理論與實務能力並行，課程涵蓋資訊科技、數位行銷與大數據分析。
vision.en: Practical, applied vocational education: theory and practice together, covering IT, digital marketing and big data.

summary.zh: 依官網課程標準表與畢業條件，整理餐飲實務、宴會管理、酒類專業知識與餐飲類證照；官網載明畢業生可前往旅館業、餐飲業等任職。
summary.en: Based on the official curriculum and graduation rules: F&B Service, Banquet Management, Wines Knowledge and F&B certificates. Graduates may work in hotels, F&B and related services.

name.zh: 採購成本與安全衛生管理

facts.zh: 系訂選修「旅館採購管理與成本控制」，2學分。
facts.en: Department elective “Hotel Purchasing Management and Cost Control”, 2 credits.

facts.zh: 系訂必修「旅館安全與衛生管理」，2學分。
facts.en: Department-required “Hotel Security & Sanitation Management”, 2 credits.

plain.zh: 課程標準表中與採購、成本及安全衛生相關的兩門課：前者為系訂選修，後者為系訂必修。
plain.en: Two courses on purchasing, cost and safety/sanitation: the first is an elective, the second is required.

facts.zh: 「餐飲實務」（Food and Beverage Service）為系訂必修，3學分。
facts.en: “Food and Beverage Service” is a department-required course, 3 credits.

facts.zh: 標註＊之系必修課程，得依班級數及實際需求彈性調整開課學期。
facts.en: Courses marked ＊ may have their semester adjusted by class size and actual needs.

label.zh: 系訂必修；開課學期依官網彈性調整

plain.zh: 餐飲實務是課程標準表中的餐飲類必修課；依配套措施，應屆畢業生若仍未取得證照，此課與房務實務與管理成績達80分以上等同通過B類一般專業證照。
plain.en: F&B Service is the required F&B course. Under the support measures, a graduating student still lacking certificates who scores 80+ in this course and Housekeeping is deemed to pass a Category B professional certificate.

name.zh: 宴會管理與酒類專業知識

facts.zh: C類含餐旅類乙級證照、WSET Level 2、IBA中階調酒、ISG Wine Fundamentals II等。
facts.en: Category C includes Level-B hospitality certs, WSET Level 2, IBA intermediate bartending, ISG Wine Fundamentals II, etc.

plain.en: The graduation table lists several F&B and beverage certificates; one Category C counts as two Category B, and Category B certificates obtained before enrollment do not count.

referenceSummary.zh:
依官網課程標準表與畢業條件，整理餐飲實務、宴會管理、酒類專業知識與餐飲類證照；官網載明畢業生可前往旅館業、餐飲業等任職。
理論與實務並重，培養兼具專業知識、技能、服務道德及敬業樂群的旅館人才。
referenceSummary.en:
Based on the official curriculum and graduation rules: F&B Service, Banquet Management, Wines Knowledge and F&B certificates. Graduates may work in hotels, F&B and related services.
Theory and practice in balance, building professional knowledge, skills, service ethics and teamwork.

vision.zh: 理論與實務並重，培養兼具專業知識、技能、服務道德及敬業樂群的旅館人才。
vision.en: Theory and practice in balance, building professional knowledge, skills, service ethics and teamwork.

name.zh: 群賢會館（校內實習旅館）

summary.zh: 群賢會館共設 12 間實習客房，108 年配合教育部紫領計畫以 AIoT 智慧旅宿修繕（導入服務機器人、AI 語音助理、TMS 任務管理與智慧門鎖），結合 Gold Touch 金鑰匙管家培訓與神秘客試住回饋。
summary.en: Qunxian Practicum Hotel features 12 AIoT smart guestrooms equipped with service robots, AI voice assistants, and TMS, supporting Gold Touch Butler training and Mystery Guest quality audits.

name.zh: 群賢會館：校內實習旅館

facts.zh: 校內實境客房規模：群賢會館共設 12 間實習客房，作為校內實習與接待校賓之場域，供示範模擬教學與實務演練。
facts.en: On-campus guestrooms: Elite House has 12 practicum guestrooms, used for on-campus practicum and hosting university guests, supporting demonstration teaching and hands-on practice.

facts.zh: AIoT 智慧旅宿升級：108 年配合教育部紫領計畫重新修繕 12 間 AIoT 智慧實習客房，導入迎賓與送物服務型機器人、AI 語音助理、TMS 任務管理系統、智慧門鎖與清潔機器人。
facts.en: AIoT Smart Hotel Upgrade: Renovated 12 smart practicum rooms with concierge/delivery robots, AI voice assistants, Task Management System (TMS), and smart locks.

facts.zh: 校內實作教學核心：支援客務實務、房務實務與管理、管家服務、校內實習（一）～（三）及中程計畫 S3 實習旅館神秘客試住檢核，為大三前往國內 24 家菁英實習合作旅館及國（海）外實習前的校內實作基地。
facts.en: Core on-campus practice venue: supports Front Office, Housekeeping, Butler Service, On-Campus Internship (I)–(III) and the S3 Mystery Guest trial stays, preparing students for Junior-year internships at the 24 Elite Internship partner hotels or overseas.

plain.zh: 群賢會館為本系校內實習旅館，共設 12 間實習客房；108 年配合教育部紫領計畫以 AIoT 智慧旅宿修繕，導入服務型機器人、AI 語音助理、TMS 任務管理與智慧門鎖，以教學與接待校賓為優先、不以營利為目標。
plain.en: Elite House (Qunxian Practicum Hotel) is the department's on-campus training hotel with 12 practicum guestrooms. Renovated in 2019 as an AIoT smart hotel under the MOE Purple-Collar Project (service robots, AI voice assistants, TMS task management and smart locks), it prioritises teaching and hosting university guests rather than profit.

facts.zh: 系網選單「群賢會館」設有訂房連結。
facts.en: The department menu “Elite House” provides a room-booking link.

facts.zh: 同一選單另設「導覽預約系統」，可預約群賢會館導覽。
facts.en: The same menu offers a “tour reservation system” for booking a tour of Elite House.

plain.zh: 想入住或參觀群賢會館，可從系網選單的訂房連結與導覽預約系統進入。
plain.en: To stay at or visit Elite House, use the booking link and tour reservation system in the department menu.

facts.zh: 系辦行政組員（分機20204）負責群賢會館實習營運場域綜整業務管理。
facts.en: Administrative staff Chen Yu-Chen (ext. 20204) manages the Elite House practice-operation site.

facts.zh: 另兩位行政組員（分機20202、20201）協辦群賢會館營運行政庶務相關事務。
facts.en: Two other administrative staff (ext. 20202, 20201) assist with Elite House operational administration.

plain.zh: 依系辦行政分工，群賢會館實習營運場域由系辦專人綜整管理，其他組員協辦行政庶務。
plain.en: Per the staff duty list, one staff member oversees the Elite House practice site while others assist with administration.

facts.zh: 「房務實務與管理」為系訂必修，3學分。
facts.en: “Housekeeping Operation and Management” is department-required, 3 credits.

facts.zh: 相關B類專業證照：勞動部勞動力發展署旅館客房服務丙級技術士。
facts.en: Related Category B certificate: Level-C Hotel Room Service technician (Ministry of Labor).

facts.zh: 中程計畫 S1「Gold Touch 金鑰匙管家培訓」於 112-2 至 114-1 學期共辦理 10 梯次、234 人次參訓；另辦理高教深耕旅館專業知能課程 12 場、166 人次，強化頂級款待與管家實作技能。
facts.en: The S1 Gold Touch Butler Training trained 234 students across 10 cohorts (AY 112-2 to 114-1), complemented by 12 Higher Education Sprout professional hospitality workshops (166 participants).

label.zh: 系訂必修；開課學期依官網彈性調整

plain.zh: 結合必修「房務實務與管理」與中程發展計畫 S1「Gold Touch 金鑰匙管家款待服務培訓」（10 梯次 234 人次），由業界名師指導儀態站姿、貴賓接待、客房整理、毛巾摺疊與服務情境演練。
plain.en: Pairs the required Housekeeping Management course with the S1 Gold Touch Butler Hospitality Training program (10 cohorts, 234 participants), featuring industry masterclasses in VIP reception, room styling, and service scenarios.

facts.zh: 課程標準表列校內實習(一)為系訂必修；校內實習(三)註記「擬刪除」。
facts.en: On-campus Internship (I) is department-required; (III) is marked “to be removed”.

facts.zh: 校內實習(二)註記「調整為系訂選修」，並列於系訂選修。
facts.en: On-campus Internship (II) is marked “changed to department elective” and listed as an elective.

label.zh: 依課程標準表（115學年度實施）

plain.zh: 依學則第28條，實習每週授課1-3小時滿一學期者為一學分；實際開課請以官網課程標準表為準。
plain.en: Per Article 28, an internship of 1–3 hours a week for a semester counts as one credit; check the official table for actual offerings.

name.zh: 場地與設備使用管理要點

facts.zh: 「本校群賢會館場地使用管理要點」最新版於1141209經校務基金管理委員會通過。
facts.en: The latest Elite House Venue Use Rules were approved by the University Fund Committee on 2025-12-09 (ROC 1141209).

facts.zh: 「本校群賢會館設備使用管理要點」於1121207經校務基金管理委員會通過。
facts.en: The Elite House Equipment Use Rules were approved by the University Fund Committee on 2023-12-07 (ROC 1121207).

plain.zh: 借用群賢會館場地或設備前，可至系網「群賢會館－相關法規」查閱管理要點全文。
plain.en: Before using Elite House venues or equipment, read the full rules under “Elite House – Regulations” on the department site.

群賢會館是本系校內實習旅館，供示範模擬教學與實務及外賓接待；系網選單提供官網、訂房、導覽預約與相關法規連結。
理論與實務並重，熟悉現代旅館內之軟硬體。
referenceSummary.en:
Elite House is the department's on-campus practice hotel for demonstration teaching, practice and receiving guests; the department menu links its website, booking, tour reservation and regulations.
Theory and practice together; familiarity with modern hotel hardware and software.

vision.zh: 理論與實務並重，熟悉現代旅館內之軟硬體。
vision.en: Theory and practice together; familiarity with modern hotel hardware and software.

summary.zh: 落實「1 張畢業證書 + 3 張專業證照（語言、資訊、專業）」制度；112–114 學年度學生共取得 1,037 人次專業證照，系上開設 CGSP、CHDT、GA 與 LINE 數位行銷考照輔導班通過率達 100%。
summary.en: Implements the 1+3 Graduation Certificate system; students earned 1,037 certifications across 2023–2025 (418 language, 303 IT/AI, 243 AHLEI, 73 hospitality), with 100% pass rates in department prep classes.

facts.zh: 1+3係指學生畢業時應具備1張畢業證書及3張相關證照。
facts.en: 1+3 means a student graduates with 1 diploma and 3 related certificates.

facts.zh: 3張證照二擇一：A類語文證照＋2張B類，或A類語文證照＋1張C類。
facts.en: The 3 certificates are either Category A + two Category B, or Category A + one Category C.

facts.zh: 112–114 學年度四類證照取得共 1,037 人次：語言類（TOEIC、JLPT、English Score）418 人次、資訊與數位類 303 人次、AHLEI 國際證照（CGSP、CHDT、CHS）243 人次、餐旅專業（勞動部、WSET）73 人次；考照輔導班（CGSP、CHDT、LINE 數位行銷、GA）參訓學員全數通過。
facts.en: 1,037 certifications earned in AY 112–114: 418 Language, 303 IT/Digital, 243 AHLEI (CGSP, CHDT, CHS), and 73 Hospitality/WSET; 100% of students attending the CGSP, CHDT, LINE Marketing, and GA prep classes passed.

plain.zh: 本系實施「1 張畢業證書 + 3 張相關證照（A 類外語 + B/C 類專業或數位證照）」制度；112-1 至 114-2 學期全系學生共取得 1,037 人次專業證照，系上開設之考照輔導班學員通過率達 100%。
plain.en: Enforces the 1+3 Graduation Certificate standard (1 diploma + 3 certifications in foreign language, hospitality, or IT/AI); students earned 1,037 certifications in AY 112–114 with a 100% pass rate in department prep classes.

facts.zh: 截至大四仍未通過相關證照者，得參加系務會議指定補救措施，成績及格視同取得。
facts.en: Students still lacking certificates by senior year may take designated remedies; passing counts as obtaining the certificate.

facts.zh: 外語報考未通過2次以上者，修第四學年進階、高階旅館英文或日文且及格，等同通過B類外語。
facts.en: Those failing a language test twice or more who pass the senior-year Intermediate and Advanced Hotel English/Japanese are deemed to meet Category B language.

plain.zh: 丙級技術士報考未通過2次以上者須修餐飲實務、房務實務與管理；應屆時成績達80分以上等同通過B類一般專業證照。
plain.en: Those failing the Level-C technician tests twice or more must take F&B Service and Housekeeping; scoring 80+ at graduation counts as a Category B professional certificate.

facts.zh: A類外語檢定標準為相當於TOEIC 600分(含)以上。
facts.en: Category A requires a language level equivalent to TOEIC 600 or above.

facts.zh: A類依「國立高雄餐旅大學四技學生英文能力檢定實施要點」辦理。
facts.en: Category A follows the university's English proficiency rules for 4-year students.

plain.zh: 不論選擇哪一種組合，A類語文證照都是必備的一張。
plain.en: Whichever combination you choose, the Category A language certificate is required.

name.zh: B類：一般專業或外語證照

facts.zh: B類專業證照列14項，如餐飲服務丙級、旅館客房服務丙級、AHLEI一般課程證書、英式管家證照。
facts.en: Category B lists 14 professional certificates, e.g. Level-C F&B Service, Level-C Room Service, AHLEI general certificate, British butler certificate.

facts.zh: B類外語證照：英語相當於TOEIC 700分以上，或日本語能力測驗N3級以上。
facts.en: Category B language: English equivalent to TOEIC 700+, or JLPT N3 or above.

label.zh: 入學後取得（入學前取得者不列計）

plain.zh: B類專業證書入學前取得者不得列入計算；清單另含Microsoft、Google與LINE等證照，詳見官網標準表。
plain.en: Category B professional certificates obtained before enrollment don't count; the list also includes Microsoft, Google and LINE certificates.

facts.zh: C類證照1張可抵2張B類證照。
facts.en: One Category C certificate counts as two Category B certificates.

facts.zh: C類例：餐旅類乙級證照、AH&LA CHS、AHLEI CHDT、TOEIC 850分以上、日檢N2以上。
facts.en: Examples: Level-B hospitality certs, AH&LA CHS, AHLEI CHDT, TOEIC 850+, JLPT N2+.

plain.zh: C類共列15項，涵蓋餐旅、酒類、外語與Microsoft、AWS、Google、LINE等證照；未列者由系務會議審查核定。
plain.en: Category C lists 15 items across hospitality, beverage, language and Microsoft/AWS/Google/LINE certificates; others are reviewed by the department meeting.

facts.zh: 現行標準適用111學年度(含)以後入學之四技日間部及進修部學生，外籍生及僑生不適用。
facts.en: The current standard applies to day and continuing-education 4-year students enrolled from AY111; not to international or overseas Chinese students.

facts.en: The site also lists versions for AY110, 108, 106, 103, 102 and 101 enrollees, plus an English version.

referenceSummary.zh:

referenceSummary.en:

name.zh: 國內外實習旅館專島（海外實習與研修・全臺24家合作旅館）
name.en: Domestic & Overseas Internship Hotels Island (Overseas Internships & 24 Domestic Hotels)

summary.zh: 於島嶼西角渡輪碼頭呈現「國（海）外實習與研修」（以新加坡為主要成長來源，另有日本實習與澳洲、美加研修；112–114 學年度累計 67 人次），並依官網合作機構表的地區，將國內「旅館菁英實習計畫3.0」24 家星級合作旅館分為北部、中部、南部、東部四區配置獨立建築與名牌（校內群賢會館則專設於第 06 島，避免重複建置）。
summary.en: Shows overseas internships and study programmes at the ferry pier on the island's west corner (Singapore is the main growth source, plus Japan internships and Australia / US-Canada study; 67 placements in AY 112–114), with all 24 individual domestic Elite Internship 3.0 partner hotels grouped into North, Central, South and East districts by the region column of the official partner table (the on-campus Qunxian Practicum Hotel is on Island 06).

name.zh: 國外／海外實習與研修（新加坡・日本・澳洲・美加）
name.en: Overseas Internships & Study (Singapore · Japan · Australia · US/Canada)

who.zh: 大三赴國（海）外實習與研修之學生
who.en: Students on overseas internships and study programmes

plain.zh: 位於實習旅館專島西角渡輪碼頭之海外地標：除島上分區配置之國內 24 家菁英實習合作星級酒店外，本系學生亦赴國（海）外實習與研修，以新加坡為主要成長來源（112–114 學年分別為 13、20、21 人），另有日本實習與澳洲、美加研修；112–114 學年度海外實習與研修累計 67 人次（16 → 24 → 27 人次，三年成長近七成）。
plain.en: Overseas landmark at the ferry pier of the Internship Hotels Island: besides the 24 domestic partner hotels, students go on overseas internships and study programmes. Singapore is the main growth source (13, 20 and 21 students in AY 112–114), with Japan internships and Australia / US-Canada study; overseas internships and study totalled 67 placements in AY 112–114 (16 → 24 → 27, up nearly 70%).

facts.zh: 新加坡（Singapore）：海外實習與研修的主要成長來源，112–114 學年分別為 13、20、21 人；「薪火相傳」講座中，學長姐分享新加坡嘉佩樂酒店實習經驗。
facts.en: Singapore: the main growth source for overseas internships and study (13, 20 and 21 students in AY 112–114); in 'Passing the Torch' talks, seniors share their internship experience at Capella Singapore.

facts.zh: 日本與澳洲、美加：日本實習每年固定 3 人，114 學年新增澳洲研修 2 人，另有美加研修。
facts.en: Japan, Australia and US/Canada: three students intern in Japan each year; Australia study was added in AY 114 (2 students), alongside US/Canada study programmes.

facts.zh: 配套與成長：申請學生須修習 EMI 或 ESP 課程，並有薪火相傳分享、行前說明、家長同意與國際處海外訪視；112–114 學年度海外實習與研修合計 67 人次（112 學年 16 人次 → 113 學年 24 人次 → 114 學年 27 人次）。
facts.en: Support and growth: applicants must take EMI or ESP courses, with seniors' sharing, pre-departure briefings, parental consent and overseas visits by the Office of International Affairs; overseas internships and study totalled 67 placements in AY 112–114 (16 → 24 → 27).

plain.zh: 國立高雄餐旅大學旅館管理系「旅館菁英實習計畫3.0」正式合作夥伴（國際奢華與跨國酒店集團合作體系）。配合大三全學年「校外實習（一）（二）」（各 10 學分），提供前六個月客房部專業培訓與第七個月起多元部門輪調及職場導師指導。
plain.en: Official partner hotel of NKUHT's Elite Internship Program 3.0 (Global Luxury Hospitality Group Partner Property), supporting Year-3 Off-Campus Internship (I) & (II) (10 credits each) with 6-month Rooms Division training followed by Month-7 departmental rotation and mentorship.

facts.zh: 官方合作夥伴：臺北文華東方酒店列於本系官網「旅館菁英實習計畫3.0」24 家合作夥伴名單（歸屬國際奢華與跨國酒店集團合作體系），點擊下方來源可直接前往飯店官方網站。
facts.en: Official Partner: Listed among the 24 official Elite Internship 3.0 partner hotels (Global Luxury Hospitality Group Partner Property) on the NKUHT Hotel Management website.

facts.zh: 客房部首階培訓與多元輪調：依「旅館菁英實習計畫3.0實施方式」，實習前六個月於客房部（如櫃檯、服務中心、客服中心／總機、訂房、商務樓層貴賓廳、房務等）培訓；通過考核面試後自第七個月起執行輪調並由職場導師（Mentor）指導。
facts.en: Rooms-First & Rotation: First 6 months in Rooms Division (Front Desk, Concierge, Guest Services, Reservations, Executive Lounge, Housekeeping); Month-7 rotation and dedicated workplace Mentor upon passing assessment.

facts.zh: 薪酬保障與優先選才：起（本）薪至少高於勞基法最低工資 5%，實習第七個月起調薪新臺幣 1,000 元（含）以上；每年 10–12 月納入本系優先選才媒合。
facts.en: Compensation & Priority Selection: Starting base pay at least 5% above statutory minimum wage, with a NT$1,000+ raise from Month 7; included in Oct–Dec priority selection.

plain.zh: 國立高雄餐旅大學旅館管理系「旅館菁英實習計畫3.0」正式合作夥伴（台灣指標觀光與星級酒店體系）。配合大三全學年「校外實習（一）（二）」（各 10 學分），提供前六個月客房部專業培訓與第七個月起多元部門輪調及職場導師指導。
plain.en: Official partner hotel of NKUHT's Elite Internship Program 3.0 (Leading Taiwan 5-Star & Resort Hospitality Group), supporting Year-3 Off-Campus Internship (I) & (II) (10 credits each) with 6-month Rooms Division training followed by Month-7 departmental rotation and mentorship.

facts.zh: 官方合作夥伴：瑞穗天合國際觀光酒店列於本系官網「旅館菁英實習計畫3.0」24 家合作夥伴名單（歸屬台灣指標觀光與星級酒店體系），點擊下方來源可直接前往飯店官方網站。
facts.en: Official Partner: Listed among the 24 official Elite Internship 3.0 partner hotels (Leading Taiwan 5-Star & Resort Hospitality Group) on the NKUHT Hotel Management website.

facts.zh: 客房部首階培訓與多元輪調：依「旅館菁英實習計畫3.0實施方式」，實習前六個月於客房部（如櫃檯、服務中心、客服中心／總機、訂房、商務樓層貴賓廳、房務等）培訓；通過考核面試後自第七個月起執行輪調並由職場導師（Mentor）指導。
facts.en: Rooms-First & Rotation: First 6 months in Rooms Division (Front Desk, Concierge, Guest Services, Reservations, Executive Lounge, Housekeeping); Month-7 rotation and dedicated workplace Mentor upon passing assessment.

facts.zh: 薪酬保障與優先選才：起（本）薪至少高於勞基法最低工資 5%，實習第七個月起調薪新臺幣 1,000 元（含）以上；每年 10–12 月納入本系優先選才媒合。
facts.en: Compensation & Priority Selection: Starting base pay at least 5% above statutory minimum wage, with a NT$1,000+ raise from Month 7; included in Oct–Dec priority selection.

label.zh: 第三學年 校外實習（一）（二）

referenceSummary.zh:
將國（海）外實習與研修（新加坡、日本、澳洲與美加）與國內「旅館菁英實習計畫3.0」24 家合作星級旅館（北部 12 家、中部 6 家、南部 5 家、東部 1 家）同島完整呈現，並於周邊海域配置渡假遊艇碼頭與海外渡假環礁。
「旅館菁英實習計畫3.0」與國（海）外實習及研習雙軌並行，為學生提供國內外星級酒店培訓輪調與國際職涯視野。
referenceSummary.en:
Presents overseas internships and study (Singapore, Japan, Australia, US/Canada) together with all 24 domestic Elite Internship 3.0 partner hotels on one island surrounded by resort marinas and atolls.
Elite Internship 3.0 runs alongside overseas internships and study programmes, offering training rotations at hotels at home and abroad.

vision.zh: 「旅館菁英實習計畫3.0」旨在為學生提供更完整、多元的培訓輪調機制，以及爭取更具競爭力的薪酬方案。
vision.en: The programme offers fuller, more varied training rotations and more competitive pay.

name.zh: 菁英實習3.0：品牌學苑、雙軌選才與輪調制度
name.en: Elite Internship 3.0: Brand Academies, Selection & Rotation

summary.zh: 整合「旅館菁英實習計畫3.0」五大制度核心：國際品牌育才合作（萬豪國際集團育才學院、IHG Academy、文華東方・W 飯店・臺北嘉佩樂育才扎根）、雙軌選才與優先選才媒合、前六個月客房部培訓與第七個月起部門輪調、實習薪酬保障與滿半年考核調薪，以及校外實習輔導小組教師訪視。
summary.en: Unites the 5 pillars of Elite Internship 3.0: global brand talent partnerships (Marriott Class, IHG Academy, and the Mandarin Oriental / W / Capella Taipei talent programme), dual-track priority selection, six months in Rooms Division followed by rotation from Month 7, stipend guarantees with a raise after six months, and faculty visits by the Internship Guidance Taskforce.

name.zh: 國際品牌育才合作（萬豪・IHG・文華東方・W 飯店・嘉佩樂）
name.en: Global Brand Talent Partnerships (Marriott · IHG · Mandarin Oriental · W · Capella)

who.zh: 修習品牌企業學苑並參與菁英實習 3.0 之學生
who.en: Students in Brand Corporate Academies & Elite Internship 3.0

plain.zh: 本系與國際品牌的合作由單點實習媒合發展為四年培育路徑：108 年萬豪實習優先選才、113.1 與台北文華東方、台北 W 飯店簽訂育才扎根計畫、113.6 臺北嘉佩樂加入、113.11 萬豪國際集團育才學院（Marriott Class）揭牌並簽訂萬豪夢想家儲備幹部培訓，另有 IHG Academy 企業學苑。
plain.en: The department's brand partnerships have grown from single internship placements into a four-year pathway: Marriott priority selection (2019), the talent programme signed with Mandarin Oriental Taipei and W Taipei (Jan 2024), Capella Taipei joining (Jun 2024), the Marriott Class launch with the Marriott Dreamer management-trainee programme (Nov 2024), and IHG Academy.

facts.zh: 萬豪國際集團育才學院（Marriott Class）與 IHG Academy：113.11 萬豪國際集團育才學院揭牌並簽訂萬豪夢想家儲備幹部培訓課程；IHG Academy 企業學苑有 27 人取得技能培訓認證、18 人通過面試進入 IHG 集團酒店實習。
facts.en: Marriott Class and IHG Academy: Marriott Class launched in Nov 2024 together with the Marriott Dreamer management-trainee programme; through IHG Academy, 27 students earned skills certification and 18 passed interviews for internships at IHG hotels.

facts.zh: 國際奢華旅館育才扎根計畫：113.1 與台北文華東方酒店、台北 W 飯店簽訂育才扎根計畫，113.6 臺北嘉佩樂酒店加入，並發展為國際奢華酒店企業學苑專班與 8 門奢華體驗管理微學分。
facts.en: Luxury hotel talent programme: signed with Mandarin Oriental Taipei and W Taipei in Jan 2024, joined by Capella Taipei in Jun 2024, and developed into the luxury hotel corporate academy class and 8 Luxury Experience Management micro-credits.

label.zh: 第二學年品牌學苑先修 至 第三學年校外實習
label.en: Sophomore Brand Academy pre-training to Junior Internship

name.zh: 雙軌選才時程、職能盤點與面試媒合
name.en: Dual-Track Selection Timeline, Competency Audit & Interviews

who.zh: 大二準備分發大三校外實習之全體學生
who.en: Sophomore students preparing for Junior internship placement

plain.zh: 建立「一般實習生」與「菁英實習生（Elite Intern）」雙軌選才機制：每年 10–12 月優先選才僅提供「國（海）外實習及研習」與經系課程及實習輔導委員會審核通過之「菁英實習 3.0 合作旅館」，並於 11–12 月舉辦面試前培訓工作坊及菁英實習生面試。
plain.en: Dual-track selection for regular and Elite Interns: the October–December priority selection is reserved for overseas internships/study and Elite Internship 3.0 hotels approved by the department's curriculum and internship committees, with pre-interview workshops and Elite Intern interviews in November–December.

facts.zh: 10–12 月優先選才專屬保留期：自 114 學年度起，每年 10–12 月優先選才時段僅開放予國（海）外實習研習機構及通過本系審核之 24 家菁英實習合作旅館。
facts.en: Oct–Dec Priority Selection Window: Starting AY 114, the Oct–Dec priority window is reserved exclusively for overseas internship partners and the 24 approved Elite Internship 3.0 hotels.

facts.zh: 菁英徵才實況：114.12.16 菁英徵才共 141 位學生參與、19 間旅館到校面試；114 年底菁英實習甄選，參與國內實習之學生全數取得名額。
facts.en: Elite recruitment: 141 students took part and 19 hotels interviewed on campus on 16 Dec 2025; in the late-2025 Elite Internship selection every student seeking a domestic internship secured a place.

label.zh: 第二學年選才媒合 至 第三學年校外實習
label.en: Sophomore selection matching to Junior internship

name.zh: 前六個月客房部培訓、第七個月起輪調與職場導師（Mentor）制
name.en: Rooms Division Training, Month-7 Rotation & Workplace Mentor

who.zh: 通過考核之菁英實習生與合作旅館培訓部門
who.en: Qualified Elite Interns & partner hotel training teams

plain.zh: 依「旅館菁英實習計畫3.0實施方式」，實習前六個月於客房部培訓，菁英生自第七個月起（至遲第八個月）轉至新實習部門及職務，並由企業指定一位職場導師（Mentor）給予個別專業指導及處事建議。
plain.en: Under the Elite Internship 3.0 rules, interns train in the Rooms Division for the first six months; Elite Interns move to a new department and role from Month 7 (Month 8 at the latest), with a workplace Mentor assigned by the hotel for individual guidance.

facts.zh: 前六個月客房部培訓：如櫃檯、服務中心、客服中心／總機、訂房、商務樓層貴賓廳、房務等。
facts.en: First six months in the Rooms Division: e.g. front desk, concierge, guest service centre / operator, reservations, executive lounge and housekeeping.

facts.zh: 五種輪調型態：（1）同一單位垂直晉升／培訓（如資深人員、實習領班／組長培訓）；（2）同一部門平行輪調或交叉訓練；（3）跨部門輪調（如客務部／餐廳外場或酒吧，不含安全部、工程部等與課程不符之單位）；（4）同集團跨館輪調；（5）實習起即為多工輪調機制。
facts.en: Five rotation types: (1) vertical promotion/training in the same unit (e.g. senior staff, intern supervisor); (2) lateral rotation or cross-training in the same department; (3) cross-department rotation (e.g. front office / restaurant or bar, excluding units such as security or engineering); (4) cross-property rotation within the group; (5) multi-task rotation from the start.

label.zh: 第三學年 校外實習（一）（二）

name.zh: 實習薪酬保障（平均 3.1–3.5 萬）、滿半年考核調薪與退場輔導
name.en: Stipend Guarantee (Avg. NT$31k–35k), 6-Month Evaluation Raise & Support

who.zh: 全體菁英實習計畫 3.0 實習生與人資考核委員會
who.en: All Elite Internship 3.0 interns & hotel HR review panels

plain.zh: 明定兩階段實習薪酬保障：入職起薪至少高於勞基法最低工資 5%（合作酒店平均實習月薪達 31,000–35,000 元），第 5–6 個月通過三階考核晉升「菁英生」後，第 7 個月起保證調薪 1,000 元以上。
plain.en: Mandates two-stage compensation protection: starting base pay >= 5% above statutory minimum wage (averaging NT$31,000–35,000/month), plus a guaranteed NT$1,000+ monthly pay raise from Month 7 upon passing the Month 5–6 review.

facts.zh: 第 5–6 個月三階段考核與 >=50% 晉升保障：第 5 個月原單位主管考核 → 人資部面談擬定輪調計畫 → 第 6 個月轉調部門主管面試；每屆候選人至少 50% 以上正式晉升「菁英生」並享第 7 個月加薪。
facts.en: Month 5–6 3-Step Review & >=50% Advancement Quota: Month-5 unit evaluation -> HR consultation -> Month-6 receiving manager interview, guaranteeing at least 50% advancement and Month-7 pay raise.

facts.zh: 3–4 週觀察輔導與雙向退場保護：未立即通過首階考核者享有 3–4 週改善輔導與二次考核機會；若因適應或健康因素需轉換為一般生，皆透過輔導機制平順銜接，保障實習學分。
facts.en: 3–4 Week Coaching & Safe Transition: Candidates needing improvement receive 3–4 weeks of coaching and a re-assessment; those transitioning to the general track retain full academic credit protection.

label.zh: 第三學年 校外實習（一）（二）

name.zh: 校外實習輔導小組與三明治雙導師全區訪視
name.en: Off-Campus Internship Guidance Taskforce & Dual-Mentor Site Visits

who.zh: 本系校外實習輔導小組教師、實習班導師與全體實習生
who.en: Internship Guidance Taskforce faculty, class advisors & interns

plain.zh: 依「校外實習輔導小組設置要點」，由系主任召集四技日間部與進修部實習班導師組成 3–7 人專案小組，每學期至少召開 2 次會議，親赴北中南東與海外實習酒店執行定期訪視、聯合訪視與個案關懷。
plain.en: Governed by the Off-Campus Internship Guidance Taskforce Guidelines, a 3–7 member faculty panel led by the Department Chair conducts regular and joint site visits across all domestic and overseas partner hotels.

facts.zh: 實習輔導教師與職場導師：系上實習輔導教師評閱學生期中、期末專業實習報告與實習日誌或週記，並出席實習輔導小組會議反映問題；菁英生自第七個月起另由企業指定職場導師（Mentor）指導。
facts.en: Faculty advisors and workplace mentors: faculty advisors review mid-term and final internship reports and internship logs or weekly journals and raise issues at taskforce meetings; from Month 7 Elite Interns also have a hotel-assigned workplace Mentor.

facts.zh: 實習機構審核與轉換審議：小組負責審核、遴選及推薦校外實習合作單位，並討論實習單位轉換與獎懲，確保大三上下學期各 10 學分（共 20 學分）實習品質。
facts.en: Placement review: the taskforce reviews, selects and recommends internship partners and handles placement transfers, rewards and discipline, safeguarding the quality of the 20-credit Junior-year internship.

label.zh: 第三學年 校外實習（一）（二）

referenceSummary.zh:
依據本系「旅館菁英實習計畫3.0實施方式」與「校外實習輔導小組設置要點」，完整呈現客房部首階培訓、五大輪調型態、薪酬保障與優先選才、考核晉升及教師訪視機制。
透過多元部門輪調機制，提升學生探索旅館營運的廣度與深度，進一步發掘其職業發展潛能。
referenceSummary.en:
Details the official Elite Internship 3.0 regulations and Off-Campus Internship Guidance system.
Rotation across departments broadens and deepens students' view of hotel operations and their career potential.

vision.zh: 透過多元部門輪調機制，提升學生探索旅館營運的廣度與深度，進一步發掘其職業發展潛能。
vision.en: Rotation across departments broadens and deepens students' view of hotel operations and their career potential.

summary.zh: 以系務、課委（含學生與業界代表）、教評、實習輔導與自我評鑑五類會議落實制度化決策與 PDCA 持續改善，並開設「智慧餐旅永續營運治理（ISO 14064／14067／50001）」推動 ESG 綠色旅宿。
summary.en: Institutionalized governance through five core committees and PDCA continuous improvement, alongside Smart Hospitality Sustainable Governance courses covering ISO 14064, ISO 14067, and ISO 50001.

facts.zh: 系網「相關法規」列有「旅館管理系務會議設置要點」，標示1140521行政會議核備。
facts.en: The regulations page lists the Department Meeting Regulations, approved by the administrative meeting on 2025-05-21 (ROC 114).

facts.zh: 官網說明本系定期及在必要時召開系務會議，以議決系內重要事項。
facts.en: The site states the department holds meetings regularly and when needed to decide important matters.

plain.zh: 系務會議是系上決定重要事項的正式會議，其設置要點公開於系網「本系規章」。
plain.en: The department meeting is the formal body for key decisions; its rules are posted under 'Department Regulations'.

name.zh: 實習合作機構遴選審核與單位轉換審議要點
name.en: Internship Partner Vetting & Unit Transfer Review Rules

facts.zh: 小組成員三至七人，系主任及四技日間部、進修部導師為當然委員。
facts.en: The group has 3–7 members; the department chair and day/continuing-program class advisors are ex officio members.

facts.zh: 每學期至少開會兩次，負責審核、遴選及推薦校外實習合作單位。
facts.en: It meets at least twice per semester and reviews, selects and recommends internship partner units.

label.zh: 第三學年校外實習(一)(二)期間

plain.zh: 依設置要點，小組也討論實習單位轉換與獎懲；學生申請轉換單位須經小組會議審議通過。
plain.en: Per its rules, the group also handles changes of internship unit and rewards/penalties; unit changes need its approval.

who.zh: 校外實習學生與輔導教師

name.zh: 計畫經費規章與獎學金指引

facts.zh: 系網「相關法規」列有「系委辦計畫行政管理費支用管理要點」。
facts.en: The regulations page lists the Rules on Administrative Fees of Commissioned Projects.

facts.zh: 獎學金部分，官網本系介紹載明「請參閱本校課外活動組之奬學金辦法」。
facts.en: For scholarships, the department intro says to consult the university Extracurricular Activities Section's rules.

plain.zh: 系上計畫經費依公開要點支用；獎學金不由系網另列，請依校方課外活動組辦法查詢。
plain.en: Project funds follow the posted rules; scholarships are handled under the university's Extracurricular Activities Section.

name.zh: PDCA 教學品質保證與聯合國 SDGs 校務治理
name.en: PDCA Quality Assurance & UN SDGs Departmental Governance

facts.zh: 115學年度課程標準表的系訂選修列有「智慧餐旅永續營運治理」，2學分。
facts.en: The AY115 curriculum lists 'Smart Hospitality for Sustainable Governance' as a 2-credit department elective.

facts.zh: 系訂選修共需25學分，畢業學分數為128學分。
facts.en: Department electives total 25 credits; graduation requires 128 credits.

facts.zh: 產學與研究鏈結：許孟鈞老師主持國科會 113 年「旅館綠色轉型ESG勢在必行、數位科技革新碳盤無所遁形－旅館綠色人才ESG素養加值教學發展模式」研究計畫，本系並承接企業「ISO 14064 溫室氣體盤查服務」產學案。
facts.en: Backed by a 2024 NSTC project on ESG literacy teaching for green hotel talent and an industry ISO 14064 GHG inventory project.

label.en: As scheduled in the curriculum standard

plain.zh: 對應中程發展計畫 S8「永續知能講座與旅館產業共創永續活動」（連結聯合國 SDGs 4、7、8、12），開設「智慧餐旅永續營運治理」課程，涵蓋 ISO 14064 溫室氣體盤查、ISO 14067 碳足跡與 ISO 50001 能源管理。
plain.en: Aligned with Mid-Term Plan S8 and UN SDGs 4, 7, 8, and 12, the Smart Hospitality Sustainable Governance course covers ISO 14064 greenhouse gas inventory, ISO 14067 carbon footprint, and ISO 50001 energy management.

facts.zh: 系網「相關法規」列有「旅館管理系自我評鑑實施要點」，標示1150521院務會議通過。
facts.en: The regulations page lists the Self-Evaluation Regulations, passed by the college meeting on 2026-05-21 (ROC 115).

facts.zh: 系上召開系務會議、教學研討會與導師會議，使系務運作制度化與合理化。
facts.en: Department meetings, teaching seminars and advisor meetings keep operations systematic and rational.

plain.zh: 自我評鑑要點是系上檢視自身辦學的公開規章，可於系網「本系規章」下載。
plain.en: The self-evaluation rules are the posted framework for reviewing the department; download them under 'Department Regulations'.

facts.zh: 系網「相關法規」列有「旅館管理系系學會組織要點」，標示1081009審議通過。
facts.en: The regulations page lists the Student Association Bylaws, approved on 2019-10-09 (ROC 108).

facts.zh: 系上指導系學會社團活動，使學生能從活動中學習組織、執行能力。
facts.en: The department guides association activities so students learn organizing and execution skills.

plain.zh: 系主任負責督導系與系學會運作；系學會依組織要點運作。
plain.en: The department chair oversees the department and the student association, which runs under its bylaws.

name.zh: 教師評審委員會設置辦法

facts.zh: 系網「相關法規」列有「旅館管理系教師評審委員會設置辦法」，標示1131023核備通過。
facts.en: The regulations page lists the Faculty Review Committee Rules, approved on 2024-10-23 (ROC 113).

facts.zh: 新進教師聘任先經系教評會初審，再經餐旅學院教評會複審，後送校教評會。
facts.en: New hires are first reviewed by the department committee, then the college committee, then the university committee.

plain.zh: 教師升等、進修等事宜亦經系教評會初審；行政組員職掌包含教師評審會議業務。
plain.en: Promotions and further study also start at the department committee; staff duties include its meeting work.

facts.zh: 系網「相關法規」列有「旅館管理系課程委員會設置要點」。
facts.en: The regulations page lists the Curriculum Committee Regulations.

facts.zh: 115學年度課程標準表經系課程會議（115.04.15）及院課程會議（115.04.21）通過。
facts.en: The AY115 curriculum passed the department (2026-04-15) and college (2026-04-21) curriculum meetings.

plain.zh: 課程標準表的修訂須經課程委員會審議；系課程委員會會議業務由行政組員承辦。
plain.en: Curriculum revisions go through the curriculum committee; its meetings are handled by department staff.

referenceSummary.zh:
對應官網「本系規章／相關法規」：系務會議、校外實習輔導小組、教評會、課程委員會等要點，並收錄課程標準表中的「智慧餐旅永續營運治理」。
依官網公開之規章運作系務，讓同學清楚知道各項制度的依據。
referenceSummary.en:
Mirrors the official 'Department Regulations' page—department meeting, internship guidance group, faculty review and curriculum committee rules—plus the elective 'Smart Hospitality for Sustainable Governance'.
Running the department by its publicly posted regulations so students know the basis of every rule.

vision.zh: 依官網公開之規章運作系務，讓同學清楚知道各項制度的依據。
vision.en: Running the department by its publicly posted regulations so students know the basis of every rule.

name.zh: 餐旅講座、競賽與系上活動

summary.zh: 學生榮獲第 54 屆全國技能競賽青年組「旅館接待」職類全國第二名；系上推動「人才薈萃：旅館行星培育發展計畫」國際大師講座、薪火相傳實習分享與國小 USR 在地陪伴服務。
summary.en: Students won 2nd Place Nationally in Hotel Reception at the 54th National Skills Competition; features Master Lectures, internship experience sharing, and elementary school USR community service.

facts.zh: 系網首頁活動花絮列有「28週年校慶」與「112學年度薪火相傳」。
facts.en: The home page activity gallery lists the 28th Anniversary and the AY112 'Passing the Torch' event.

facts.zh: 另列有「112學年度偏鄉關懷」與「112學年度新生職涯講座」。
facts.en: It also lists AY112 Rural Outreach and the AY112 Freshman Career Talk.

facts.zh: 社會服務與公民素養：學生前往金山國小（70 人次）、龍目國小（51 人次）、華山國小（40 人次）辦理在地陪伴服務；每學期舉辦「薪火相傳」講座，由赴新加坡嘉佩樂酒店及國內奢華酒店實習之學長姐傳承經驗。
facts.en: USR Community Service: Students organized companionship programs at Jinshan (70), Longmu (51), and Huashan (40) Elementary Schools, alongside 'Passing the Torch' sharing by Capella Singapore and luxury hotel interns.

plain.zh: 本系將品德涵養與公民素養融入真實場域，每學期舉辦師生座談（出席率約九成）、「薪火相傳」海內外實習學長姐經驗分享，並推動國小 USR 偏鄉陪伴社會服務（金山、龍目、華山國小累計 161 人次參與）。
plain.en: Cultivates character and civic responsibility through semesterly faculty-student forums (~90% attendance), internship experience sharing, and USR elementary school companionship programs (161 student participants).

name.zh: 服務設計與餐旅專題講座

facts.zh: 院訂必修「服務設計與創新」（Service Design and Innovation），3學分。
facts.en: 'Service Design and Innovation' is a 3-credit college-required course.

facts.zh: 系訂必修「餐旅專題講座」（Hospitality Seminars），1學分。
facts.en: 'Hospitality Seminars' is a 1-credit department-required course.

facts.zh: 「人才薈萃」與專題講座主題涵蓋台北文華東方酒店五感奢華體驗、國際旅館大師演講、ESG 永續經營實務、線上廣告與數位行銷趨勢、以及菁英實習面試增能。
facts.en: Master Lecture topics span Mandarin Oriental Taipei's five-sense luxury experience, international hotelier keynotes, ESG practices, digital advertising trends, and executive interview preparation.

label.en: As scheduled in the curriculum standard

plain.zh: 112–114 學年度密集舉辦餐旅專題講座（112-2 學期 16 場 1,269 人次、113-1 學期 19 場 1,250 人次），114-1 學期起更升級為全系規模之 S6「人才薈萃：旅館行星培育發展計畫」國際大師講座（單場約 230 人次）。
plain.en: Hosted over 40 Hospitality Seminars (>3,000 attendees) across AY 112–114, upgrading in AY 114-1 to department-wide S6 'Talent Convergence' Master Lectures (~230 attendees per session).

facts.zh: 沙荃老師通過全國技能競賽裁判資格甄選，並擔任旅館客房服務技術士技能檢定監評。
facts.en: Prof. Sha Quan passed the national skills competition judge selection and is an examiner for the hotel room service skills test.

facts.zh: 沙荃老師為全國技能競賽旅館接待選手（第一名、第二名、第三名）指導老師。
facts.en: Prof. Sha Quan coached national skills competition hotel reception contestants who placed 1st, 2nd and 3rd.

facts.zh: 第 54 屆全國技能競賽青年組「旅館接待」職類榮獲全國第二名（勞動部頒發獎狀）；本系師生亦受邀負責「2025 萬豪國際新秀廚師競賽」現場貴賓接待與會場專業服務。
facts.en: Won 2nd Place Nationally in Hotel Reception at the 54th National Skills Competition (Ministry of Labor); faculty and students also led VIP reception for the 2025 Marriott International Young Chef Competition.

plain.zh: 本系學生榮獲「第 54 屆全國技能競賽青年組—旅館接待職類」全國第二名殊榮！本系教師同時擔任全國技能競賽與亞洲技能競賽國手選拔賽「旅館接待」職類裁判長，選手培訓標準與國際及國家級賽事全面對齊。
plain.en: Department students won 2nd Place Nationally in Hotel Reception (Youth Division) at the 54th National Skills Competition, trained under faculty who serve as Chief Judge for the National and Asian Skills Competitions.

who.zh: 有意參與技能競賽的同學

referenceSummary.zh:
彙整官網活動花絮、課程標準表中的「服務設計與創新」與「餐旅專題講座」，以及專技教師的全國技能競賽指導經歷。
讓同學從活動、講座與競賽中把課堂所學延伸到實務。
referenceSummary.en:
Official department event albums, the courses 'Service Design and Innovation' and 'Hospitality Seminars', plus National Skills Competition coaching.
Helping students extend classroom learning through activities, seminars and competitions.

vision.zh: 讓同學從活動、講座與競賽中把課堂所學延伸到實務。
vision.en: Helping students extend classroom learning through activities, seminars and competitions.

summary.zh: 與全球 70 所學府及國際機構（62 所海外大學、8 家國際企業）簽署合作協議；112–114 學年海外實習與研修達 67 人次（涵蓋新加坡嘉佩樂等頂級酒店、日本、澳洲、美加），三年成長近七成。
summary.en: Partnered with 70 global institutions (62 universities and 8 international hospitality groups); 67 students completed overseas internships and study programs across Singapore, Japan, Australia, and North America.

name.zh: 國際交流資訊網與華語組

facts.zh: 系網選單「招生資訊」連結本校「國際交流資訊網」與「語文中心華語組」。
facts.en: The site menu's Admissions section links to the university International Exchange site and Language Center Mandarin Division.

facts.zh: 畢業條件標準表載明外籍生及僑生不適用。
facts.en: The graduation requirements state they do not apply to international and overseas Chinese students.

facts.zh: 國際合作姊妹校涵蓋加拿大 Humber College、澳洲 Griffith University、英國 University College Birmingham（UCB）、紐西蘭 University of Waikato 等 62 所學府及 8 家國際業界機構。
facts.en: Sister institutions include Humber College (Canada), Griffith University (Australia), University College Birmingham (UK), and the University of Waikato (New Zealand) among 62 universities and 8 industry groups.

plain.zh: 本系與全球 70 所學府與國際機構（62 所海外大學、8 家國際餐旅機構）簽有學術交流與實習合作協議；114 學年度在學境外生共 26 人（來自印尼、馬來西亞、越南、日本等 9 國）及國際專修部學生，華語採分級教學。
plain.en: Maintains academic exchange and internship agreements with 70 global partners (62 overseas universities and 8 international hospitality organizations), hosting international students from 9 countries.

who.zh: 境外生與對國際交流有興趣者

name.zh: 國(海)外實習及研習選才

facts.zh: 自114學年度起，優先選才機制於每年10~12月僅提供國(海)外實習及研習與審核通過之菁英實習業者。
facts.en: From AY114, priority selection (Oct–Dec yearly) is offered only to overseas internship/study and approved elite-internship hotels.

facts.zh: 國(海)外實習及研習的選才機制與時程，依研究發展處及國際事務處等單位公告辦理。
facts.en: Selection and timeline for overseas internship/study follow announcements by the R&D Office and International Affairs Office.

facts.zh: 海外實習與研修配套完善：新加坡為主要成長據點（112 至 114 學年分別為 13、20、21 人），日本每年穩定選送，並拓展澳洲與美加研修；申請學生須修習 EMI 或 ESP 課程，並由國際處與系上教師進行海外訪視輔導。
facts.en: Comprehensive overseas support: Singapore placements grew from 13 to 21 students/year alongside Japan, Australia, and North America programs, supported by EMI/ESP prerequisites and overseas faculty visits.

label.zh: 每年10～12月優先選才（依官網）

plain.zh: 112–114 學年度海外實習與海外研修累計達 67 人次（112 學年 16 人次 → 113 學年 24 人次 → 114 學年 27 人次，三年成長近七成），版圖涵蓋新加坡（含新加坡嘉佩樂酒店等）、日本、澳洲研修與美加研修。
plain.en: Overseas internships and study programs reached 67 student placements across AY 112–114 (growing nearly 70% from 16 in AY 112 to 27 in AY 114), spanning Singapore (including Capella Singapore), Japan, Australia, and North America.

facts.zh: 系訂選修列有「海外參訪(一)」與「海外參訪(二)」（Field Study），各1學分。
facts.en: Department electives include Field Study (I) and (II), 1 credit each.

facts.zh: 學生欲選修海外參訪（二）須修畢海外參訪（一）。
facts.en: Field Study (I) must be completed before taking Field Study (II).

label.en: As scheduled in the curriculum standard

plain.zh: 海外參訪為115學年度日間部四技課程標準表中的系訂選修，須依先修規定選課。
plain.en: Field Study is a department elective in the AY115 day-program curriculum with a prerequisite rule.

name.zh: 海外實習視野與越南生專班

facts.zh: 課程規劃推動精進外語能力，並鼓勵至國際觀光旅館與海外實習以拓展視野。
facts.en: The curriculum promotes foreign-language skills and encourages internships at international hotels and abroad.

facts.zh: 沿革記載本系於九十六年招收四年制旅館管理系外籍－越南生專班。
facts.en: In 2007 (ROC 96) the department admitted a 4-year international class for Vietnamese students.

plain.zh: 系訂選修另有「國際禮儀」與「跨文化服務與管理」等課程，可搭配海外學習規劃。
plain.en: Electives such as International Etiquette and Cross-cultural Service and Management can support overseas plans.

who.zh: 對國際旅館職涯有興趣者

referenceSummary.zh:
整理官網中與國際相關的內容：海外參訪課程、國(海)外實習及研習的優先選才、課程規劃鼓勵海外實習，以及國際交流資訊網等連結。
依官網課程規劃，鼓勵同學至國際觀光旅館與海外實習以拓展視野。
referenceSummary.en:
Collects the international items on the official site: Field Study courses, priority selection for overseas internships, the curriculum's encouragement of overseas internships, and links such as the International Exchange site.
Following the official curriculum plan, encouraging internships at international hotels and abroad to broaden horizons.

vision.zh: 依官網課程規劃，鼓勵同學至國際觀光旅館與海外實習以拓展視野。
vision.en: Following the official curriculum plan, encouraging internships at international hotels and abroad to broaden horizons.

summary.zh: 112–114 學年度累計開設 EMI 全英語授課 37 門次（14 門課、8 位教師，其中 5 位教師具全英授課專業證照），結合英語畢業門檻、系訂必修旅館英文(一)與旅館日文(一)(二)，以及日語、法語、粵語第二外語培育。
summary.en: 37 EMI (English as a Medium of Instruction) course sections in AY 112–114 (14 courses, 8 teachers; 5 teachers hold EMI teaching certificates), alongside an English graduation threshold, required Hotel English (I) and Hotel Japanese (I)(II), and Japanese, French and Cantonese as second languages.

name.zh: 特色目標：精通外國語言

facts.zh: 本系特色目標之一為「精通外國語言」。
facts.en: One of the department's distinctive goals is “mastery of foreign languages”.

facts.zh: 課程規劃推動精進外語能力，並鼓勵至國際觀光旅館與海外實習以拓展視野。
facts.en: The curriculum promotes stronger language skills and encourages internships at international hotels and overseas.

facts.zh: 112–114 學年度 EMI 全英授課累計 37 門次（14 門課、8 位教師）；本系教師持有全英授課專業證照（5 位）、RELC、倫敦大學亞非學院（SOAS）學術英文、日本語能力 N1 與日語導遊等專業語文資歷。
facts.en: 37 EMI sections across 14 courses in AY 112–114; faculty hold EMI teaching certifications (5 faculty), RELC and SOAS academic English credentials, and JLPT N1 / Japanese tour guide licenses.

plain.zh: 落實中程發展計畫 S5「EMI 與全英課程推動」，112–114 學年度累計開設 EMI 全英語授課 37 門次（涵蓋 14 門專業課程、8 位教師投入，其中 5 位教師取得全英授課專業證照），並依畢業條件標準表設英語門檻（A 類相當於 TOEIC 600 分以上），另開設日、法、粵語第二外語課程。
plain.en: Advances Mid-Term Plan S5 (EMI Promotion) with 37 English-Medium Instruction course sections across 14 subjects taught by 8 faculty members during AY 112–114, paired with Japanese, French, and Cantonese courses.

facts.zh: 校訂必修含語文－英文（讀/寫）（一）（二）與語文-餐旅英語會話（一）（二）。
facts.en: University-required courses include English (Reading & Writing) I–II and Hospitality English Conversation I–II.

facts.zh: 校訂必修另含語文-第二外語及職場英文（Workplace English）。
facts.en: They also include a Second Foreign Language and Workplace English.

label.zh: 校訂必修；學期依課程標準表

plain.zh: 這些語文課屬校訂必修（共36學分）的一部分；系上另開設旅館英文、旅館日文課程。
plain.en: These are part of the 36 university-required credits; the department separately offers Hotel English and Japanese.

facts.zh: TOEIC 850分(含)以上者可申請旅館英文(一)免修，學分須選修餐旅學院其他必修課程補足。
facts.en: TOEIC 850+ holders may apply for exemption from Hotel English (I), making up credits with other College required courses.

facts.zh: 日檢N3(含)以上者可申請旅館日文(一)(二)免修，以應用日語系課程或本系大二、大四日文選修補足。
facts.en: JLPT N3+ holders may apply for exemption from Hotel Japanese (I)(II), making up credits via Applied Japanese courses or the dept.'s year-2/4 Japanese electives.

plain.zh: 申請免修須檢附測驗證明正本及影本，並依本校「學生抵免學分要點」及「學生選課辦法」辦理。
plain.en: Applicants submit the original and a copy of the test certificate, following the university's credit-exemption and course-selection rules.

name.zh: 進階與高階旅館英日文

facts.zh: 第四學年第1學期開設「進階旅館英文」「進階旅館日文」，各2學分2小時選修。
facts.en: Senior year, semester 1: “Intermediate Hotel English” and “Intermediate Hotel Japanese”, electives of 2 credits/2 hours each.

facts.zh: 第四學年第2學期開設「高階旅館英文」「高階旅館日文」，各2學分2小時選修。
facts.en: Senior year, semester 2: “Advanced Hotel English” and “Advanced Hotel Japanese”, electives of 2 credits/2 hours each.

plain.zh: 外語報考未通過2次以上者，若應屆仍未取得證照，修這兩門且及格，等同通過B類外語證照門檻。
plain.en: For those failing a language test twice or more, passing these two courses at graduation counts as meeting Category B language.

name.zh: 國際禮儀與跨文化服務

facts.zh: 系訂選修「國際禮儀」（International Etiquette），2學分。
facts.en: Department elective “International Etiquette”, 2 credits.

facts.zh: 系訂選修「跨文化服務與管理」，2學分。
facts.en: Department elective “Cross-cultural Service and Management”, 2 credits.

label.zh: 系訂選修；學期依課程標準表

plain.zh: 想加強國際接待與跨文化服務能力，可選修這兩門系訂選修課程。
plain.en: Students wishing to strengthen international and cross-cultural service can take these two electives.

facts.zh: 「旅館英文(一)」（Hotel English I）為系訂必修，2學分。
facts.en: “Hotel English (I)” is department-required, 2 credits.

facts.zh: 旅館英文(二)、(三)、(四)列於系訂選修，各2學分。
facts.en: Hotel English (II), (III) and (IV) are department electives, 2 credits each.

label.zh: 必修＋選修；學期依課程標準表

plain.zh: 從必修的旅館英文(一)開始，可再選修(二)～(四)，第四學年另有進階、高階旅館英文。
plain.en: Start with required Hotel English (I), add electives (II)–(IV), and in senior year Intermediate and Advanced Hotel English.

facts.zh: 「旅館日文(一)」「旅館日文(二)」為系訂必修，各2學分。
facts.en: “Hotel Japanese (I)” and “(II)” are department-required, 2 credits each.

facts.zh: 旅館日文(三)、(四)列於系訂選修，各2學分；抵免規定提及本系大二或大四之日文選修。
facts.en: Hotel Japanese (III) and (IV) are electives, 2 credits each; the exemption rule cites the dept.'s year-2 or year-4 Japanese electives.

label.zh: 必修＋選修；日文選修見大二、大四

plain.zh: 日文課從必修(一)(二)開始，可續修(三)(四)與第四學年的進階、高階旅館日文。
plain.en: Japanese starts with required (I)(II), continuing to (III)(IV) and senior-year Intermediate and Advanced Hotel Japanese.

facts.zh: A類外語相當於TOEIC 600分以上；B類外語為TOEIC 700分以上或日檢N3以上。
facts.en: Category A: TOEIC 600 equivalent+; Category B language: TOEIC 700+ or JLPT N3+.

facts.zh: C類含英語相當於TOEIC 850分以上或日本語能力測驗N2級以上。

summary.zh: 整合 Oracle OPERA 與德安資訊兩套 PMS 系統與 Power BI 大數據分析、生成式 AI、服務型機器人及 ISO 14064 永續治理，攜手犀動智能、微軟、AWS、Oracle 等科技夥伴，推動 OPERA 證書與 AI-900／AWS 雙軌認證。
summary.en: Integrates Oracle OPERA and Dean PMS with Power BI analytics, Generative AI, service robots, and ISO 14064 sustainability, partnering with Aiello, Microsoft, AWS, and Oracle for dual-track certifications.

name.zh: 旅館資訊管理系統（OPERA／德安PMS）
name.en: Hotel Information Management Systems (OPERA / Dean PMS)

facts.zh: 特殊設備列有旅館資訊管理系統：Oracle Hospitality OPERA PMS與德安資訊PMS飯店前台管理系統。
facts.en: Official special equipment includes hotel information management systems: Oracle Hospitality OPERA PMS and Dean Information PMS front-desk system.

facts.zh: 教學環境另設有智能服務中心、旅館資訊管理專業教室與旅館專業技術教室。
facts.en: The teaching environment also has a smart service center, a hotel information management classroom and a hotel technical skills classroom.

facts.zh: OPERA 系列研習（資產系統導論、實戰基礎、實戰進階）邀請台北 W 飯店等國際品牌主管協同授課，結合理論操作與住房專案建置，培育數位旅宿管理即戰力。
facts.en: OPERA workshop series (Introduction, Practical Foundation, Advanced Practice) are co-taught by executives from W Taipei and international chains, certifying students in PMS operations.

label.zh: 四年皆適用（依官網特殊設備）

plain.en: Integrates two Property Management Systems—Oracle OPERA and Dean PMS—complemented by basic-to-advanced OPERA executive workshops with department-issued completion certificates.

name.zh: 旅館資產管理系統與資訊科技課程

facts.en: The AY115 curriculum lists "Hotel Property Management System and Operation" as a department-required course.

facts.zh: 系訂必修亦列有「餐旅資訊科技應用實務」。

plain.zh: 對應官網課程規劃：課程亦涵蓋資訊科技、數位行銷與大數據分析等內容，與旅館產業發展趨勢接軌。

name.zh: 餐旅人工智慧、機器人與大數據

facts.zh: 115學年度課程標準表系訂必修列有「餐旅人工智慧管理」。
facts.en: The AY115 curriculum lists "AI in Hospitality Management" as a department-required course.

facts.zh: 系訂選修列有「餐旅自動化機器人應用實務」、「餐旅大數據視覺化應用」與「智慧餐旅永續營運治理」。
facts.en: Department electives include Hospitality Autonomous Robots Practical Applications, Hospitality Big Data and Strategic Planning, and Smart Hospitality for Sustainable Governance.

facts.zh: 智慧科技合作夥伴涵蓋犀動智能（Aiello）、緯創數技、季河資訊、德安資訊、資策會、微軟（Microsoft）、AWS 與 Oracle；許孟鈞老師並主持國科會 114–115 年多年期計畫「基於小語言模型(SLM)與檢索增強生成(RAG)的服務溫度感知對話式餐旅機器人：跨世代生成式AI素養教學模式的實證研究」。
facts.en: Tech partners include Aiello, Wistron Digital Tech, Jihe Info, Dean Info, III, Microsoft, AWS, and Oracle; a faculty member also leads a 2025–2026 multi-year NSTC project on SLM & RAG conversational hospitality robots.

label.zh: 系訂必修／選修（115學年度課程標準表）

plain.zh: 本系資訊科技課程由紫領計畫演進為智慧化課程體系，定位於「培養會使用系統、看得懂數據、能評估 AI 導入的旅館管理者」；113 年 4 月更簽署「國際奢華旅館智能科技服務共創聯盟合作備忘錄」。
plain.en: Designed to cultivate hotel managers who master operational systems, interpret data, and evaluate AI adoption; anchored by the Luxury Hotel Smart Tech Co-Creation Alliance MOU signed in April 2024.

facts.en: College electives: Cloud Business Software Application, Digital Media Content Design, Hospitality Self-Media Marketing (2 credits / 2 hours each).

facts.zh: 系訂選修另列有「餐旅數位行銷」；官網發展特色亦強調數位行銷能力。
facts.en: "Hospitality Digital Marketing" is a department elective; the official development features also stress digital marketing ability.

label.zh: 院訂選修／系訂選修（115學年度課程標準表）

plain.zh: 官網課程規劃指出課程涵蓋數位行銷；師資頁所列專任教師專長亦包含雲端科技應用、電子商務與數位行銷。
plain.en: The official curriculum plan covers digital marketing; faculty specialties listed on the official pages include cloud technology applications, e-commerce and digital marketing.

name.zh: 數位與 AI 類畢業證照

facts.zh: 114-1 學期開設 LINE 官方數位行銷與 Google Analytics（GA）等 4 門 6 班考照輔導班（單學期 169 人通過，參訓通過率 100%），112–114 學年全系累計取得 303 人次資訊類證照。
facts.en: Offered 6 digital certification prep classes in AY 114-1 (169 students passed with a 100% pass rate), contributing to 303 IT/digital certifications earned across AY 112–114.

label.zh: 111學年度起入學適用（畢業條件標準表）
label.en: For students enrolled from AY111 (graduation rules)

plain.zh: 推動「OPERA 研習結業證書 + Microsoft Azure AI-900／AWS Certified AI Practitioner／Google Analytics（GA）／LINE 官方帳號專家認證」雙軌數位認證，112–114 學年度學生共取得 303 人次資訊類證照。
plain.en: Promotes dual-track digital certification combining OPERA completion certificates with Azure AI-900, AWS AI Practitioner, Google Analytics, and LINE Official Account certifications (303 IT certifications earned in AY 112–114).

官網特殊設備列有 OPERA PMS 與德安資訊PMS；課程涵蓋資訊科技、數位行銷與大數據分析，畢業條件亦列有數位／AI 類證照。

Official facilities include OPERA PMS and Dean PMS; the curriculum covers IT, digital marketing and big-data analysis, and the graduation rules list digital/AI certificates.
