vision.en: To cultivate hotel professionals with IT application, digital marketing and big-data analysis abilities (per the official development features).

name.zh: 畢業出路、產業學院與儲備幹部職涯藍海
name.en: Graduate Careers, Industry Academy & MT Fast-Track

summary.zh: 畢業生就業比例 86.79%、雇主整體滿意度 4.33 分（滿分 5 分，112 年調查），本校獲《遠見》企業最愛大學生「觀光休閒類」第 1 名（校級排名）；透過「三合一策略」、「產業學院」與國際品牌儲備幹部直通機制，銜接月薪 4 萬元以上職涯起點與國內外研究所升學。
summary.en: 86.79% graduate employment and 4.33/5 employer satisfaction (2023 survey); NKUHT ranks No. 1 in the Tourism & Leisure category of Global Views' 'Most Wanted Graduates' (university-level). The Three-in-One Strategy, the Industry Academy and global-brand management-trainee pathways lead to starting salaries of NT$40,000+ or graduate study.

facts.zh: 畢業生可前往旅館業、餐飲業或住宿等相關服務業，以及與本系課程領域相近之公私立機構任職。
facts.en: Graduates may work in hotels, food & beverage, lodging and related services, or public/private organizations in related fields.

facts.zh: 升學管道如國內各大學相關研究所、餐旅管理研究所、國外大學旅館管理或觀光餐飲研究所。
facts.en: Further study options include related graduate institutes in Taiwan, hospitality management institutes, and overseas graduate programs in hotel or tourism & F&B management.

facts.zh: 雇主滿意度調查最獲業界肯定之五項表現：學習能力及意願（4.41 分）、工作態度（4.37 分）、知識技能（4.36 分）、專業證照（4.35 分）與團隊合作（4.35 分）。
facts.en: Top 5 employer-rated graduate strengths (out of 5.0): Learning Ability & Willingness (4.41), Work Attitude (4.37), Professional Knowledge & Skills (4.36), Certifications (4.35), and Teamwork (4.35).

label.zh: 畢業後（依官網本系介紹）

plain.zh: 依 112–113 學年度畢業生流向調查，本系畢業生就業比例 86.79%，雇主整體滿意度 4.33 分（滿分 5 分，112 年調查）；本校獲《遠見》2024–2026 企業最愛大學生「觀光休閒類」第 1 名（校級排名）。
plain.en: Per the AY 112–113 graduate survey, 86.79% of graduates are employed and employer satisfaction is 4.33/5 (2023 survey); NKUHT ranked No. 1 in the Tourism & Leisure category of Global Views' 2024–2026 'Most Wanted Graduates' (university-level ranking).

name.zh: 三合一策略與就業輔導

facts.zh: 系上積極推動「三合一策略」：與業界建立良性密切互動，學生充分獲得校外實習機會，畢業後即可順利就業。
facts.en: The department promotes a "three-in-one strategy": close ties with industry give students ample internships and smooth employment after graduation.

facts.zh: 系務工作包含積極規劃學生就業輔導工作，並聘請產、官、學專業學者蒞系進行餐旅專題演講。
facts.en: Department work includes planning career guidance and inviting experts from industry, government and academia for hospitality talks.

label.zh: 四年皆適用（依官網行政與系務）

plain.zh: 為達「校外實習乃校內學習之延伸」的教育功能，本系教師均定期赴學生實習場所訪視，並與旅館業界保持密切連繫。
plain.en: So that off-campus internship extends on-campus learning, faculty regularly visit internship sites and keep close contact with the hotel industry.

facts.zh: 建構「產業學院」為本系發展特色目標，透過與旅館產業界密切合作與深耕。
facts.en: Building an "industry academy" is the department's development goal, through close and deep cooperation with the hotel industry.

facts.zh: 期能提高業界穩定性極高的人力資源，也為本系學生開創順利就業之藍海。
facts.en: It aims to provide the industry with highly stable human resources and open a blue ocean of employment for students.

label.zh: 四年皆適用（依官網發展特色）

plain.zh: 發展特色藉由校內學習專業理論及校外赴旅館產業實習，預期理論與實際兼具，使學生畢業後符合業界及社會所需。
plain.en: The development feature combines on-campus theory with off-campus hotel internships, so graduates meet industry and social needs.

name.zh: 國際品牌儲備幹部（MT）直通與起薪躍升（月薪 4 萬元以上）
name.en: Global Brand Management Trainee (MT) Fast-Track & Career Launch

facts.zh: 四年品牌共育路徑：大一、大二職涯探索與品牌說明會，大三一年校外實習與跨部門輪調，大四潛力學生銜接儲備主管培訓；合作包含萬豪夢想家儲備幹部培訓（113.11 簽約）、IHG Academy 與國際奢華旅館育才扎根計畫。
facts.en: Four-year brand pathway: career exploration and brand info sessions in Years 1–2, a year-long internship with cross-department rotation in Year 3, and management-trainee preparation for high-potential seniors in Year 4; partners include the Marriott Dreamer programme (signed Nov 2024), IHG Academy and the luxury hotel talent programme.

facts.zh: 管理職能銜接：系訂選修列有旅館督導實務、旅館管理個案探討、餐旅大數據視覺化應用與智慧餐旅永續營運治理等課程，協助將實習經驗轉化為督導與管理能力。
facts.en: Management skills: department electives such as Supervision in the Hotel Industry, Hotel Management Case Studies, Hospitality Big Data and Strategic Planning, and Smart Hospitality for Sustainable Governance help turn internship experience into supervisory skills.

facts.zh: 儲備幹部直通：畢業後透過儲備幹部直通機制，通過遴選的學生可銜接月薪 4 萬元以上的職涯起點。
facts.en: Management-trainee pathway: after graduation, students who pass selection can start on NT$40,000+ per month through the management-trainee pathway.

label.zh: 第四學年儲備主管培訓與畢業後就業

plain.zh: 串聯大三校外實習歷練與大四儲備主管培訓，透過萬豪、IHG、文華東方、W 飯店與嘉佩樂等國際品牌合作，建立畢業儲備幹部直通機制，通過遴選者可銜接月薪 4 萬元以上之職涯起點。
plain.en: Linking the Junior-year internship with senior-year management-trainee preparation, partnerships with Marriott, IHG, Mandarin Oriental, W and Capella provide a management-trainee pathway; graduates who pass selection start on NT$40,000+ per month.

who.zh: 大四準畢業生與完成菁英實習之優秀學員

name.zh: 國內外研究所升學管道與系友兼任授課
name.en: Graduate Study Pathways & Alumni Adjunct Teaching

facts.zh: 升學進修管道：主要進修管道如國內各大學相關研究所、餐旅管理研究所、國外大學旅館管理或觀光餐飲研究所等。
facts.en: Further study: main routes include related graduate institutes at universities in Taiwan, hospitality management graduate institutes, and overseas graduate programmes in hotel management or tourism and F&B.

facts.zh: 系友返校兼任授課：本系延攬本系畢業且於旅館飯店工作之優秀校友蒞校兼任授課或主講「餐旅講座」；學長姐亦透過「薪火相傳」講座分享實習經驗。
facts.en: Alumni teaching: outstanding alumni working in hotels return as adjunct teachers or speakers in the Hospitality Seminars; seniors also share internship experience in 'Passing the Torch' talks.

label.zh: 第四學年升學準備與畢業後發展

plain.zh: 畢業生可前往旅館業、餐飲業或住宿等相關服務業就業，或報考國內各大學相關研究所、餐旅管理研究所、國外大學旅館管理或觀光餐飲研究所；系上亦延攬於旅館飯店工作之優秀校友蒞校兼任授課或主講餐旅講座。
plain.en: Graduates work in hotels, F&B or lodging services, or go on to related graduate institutes in Taiwan, hospitality management institutes, or overseas graduate programmes in hotel or tourism and F&B management; outstanding alumni working in hotels return as adjunct teachers or seminar speakers.

who.zh: 大四規劃升學進修學生與歷屆海內外系友
who.en: Seniors pursuing graduate studies & global HTL alumni

referenceSummary.zh:
官網說明畢業生的就業方向與升學管道；系上推動「三合一策略」與「產業學院」，並以旅館菁英實習計畫3.0提供培訓輪調與薪酬方案。
透過與旅館產業界密切合作與深耕，為學生開創順利就業之藍海（依官網發展特色）。
referenceSummary.en:
The official site describes graduates' career paths and further-study options; the department promotes the "three-in-one strategy" and an "industry academy", and offers rotation training and pay terms through the Elite Internship Program 3.0.
Through close, deep cooperation with the hotel industry, open a blue ocean of smooth employment for students (per the official development features).

vision.zh: 透過與旅館產業界密切合作與深耕，為學生開創順利就業之藍海（依官網發展特色）。
vision.en: Through close, deep cooperation with the hotel industry, open a blue ocean of smooth employment for students (per the official development features).

name.zh: 奢華體驗與金鑰匙管家

summary.zh: 呼應「智慧旅館科技 × 奢華體驗管理」雙主軸定位：由國際奢華酒店企業學苑專班轉化為 8 門奢華體驗管理微學分（113-2 至 114-2，皆已完成三級三審），結合中程計畫 S1「Gold Touch 金鑰匙管家款待服務培訓」與 S3 群賢會館神秘客培訓與反饋
summary.en: Anchoring the 'Smart Hotel Tech × Luxury Experience Management' dual axis: the luxury hotel corporate academy class evolved into 8 Luxury Experience Management micro-credits (AY 113-2 to 114-2, all approved through three-level review), alongside S1 Gold Touch butler training and S3 Mystery Guest training at Elite House

name.zh: 奢華體驗管理微學分（8 門三級三審課程）

who.zh: 旅館管理系・微學分創新課程
who.en: Dept. of Hotel Management · Micro-Credit Curriculum

facts.zh: 三級三審：8 門奢華體驗管理微學分皆已完成三級三審，由 113 學年國際奢華酒店企業學苑專班之學生回饋與業界檢討轉化而來，核心為顧客體驗設計與情緒價值創造。
facts.en: Three-level review: all 8 Luxury Experience Management micro-credits have passed three-level review; they grew out of student feedback and industry review of the AY 113 luxury hotel corporate academy class, centring on customer experience design and emotional value creation.

facts.zh: 113-2 學期 4 門：人格特質剖析與旅館職業、行為面談解析及實務應用、國際連鎖品牌導論及領導統御、奢華酒店管家服務。
facts.en: Four courses in 113-2: Personality Analysis and Hotel Careers; Behavioural Interview Analysis and Practice; Introduction to International Hotel Brands and Leadership; Luxury Hotel Butler Service.

facts.zh: 114-1 學期 2 門：旅館禮賓諮詢技巧、客房向上銷售技巧；114-2 學期 2 門：實習職前準備與職場認知、國際品牌連鎖旅館發展史。
facts.en: Two courses in 114-1: Hotel Concierge Consultation Skills; Room Upselling Skills. Two in 114-2: Pre-Internship Preparation and Workplace Awareness; History of International Hotel Chains.

facts.zh: 補足正式課程：微學分補足正式課程較難涵蓋的品牌文化、服務哲學與高端顧客關係管理，部分課程與 W 飯店主管共同規劃。
facts.en: Complementing the formal curriculum: the micro-credits cover brand culture, service philosophy and high-end guest relationship management, with some courses planned together with W Hotel managers.

plain.zh: 8 門奢華體驗管理微學分（113-2 學期 4 門、114-1 學期 2 門、114-2 學期 2 門）皆已完成三級三審，由國際奢華酒店企業學苑專班經驗轉化而來，聚焦顧客體驗設計與情緒價值創造。
plain.en: 8 Luxury Experience Management micro-credits (4 in 113-2, 2 in 114-1, 2 in 114-2), all approved through three-level review, grew out of the luxury hotel corporate academy class and focus on customer experience design and emotional value creation.

name.zh: Gold Touch 金鑰匙管家款待服務培訓

who.zh: 旅館管理系・國際禮賓與管家實務
who.en: Dept. of Hotel Management · Concierge & Butler Practice

facts.zh: 中程發展計畫 S1：「Gold Touch 金鑰匙管家款待服務培訓」於 112-2 至 114-1 學期共辦理 10 梯次、234 人次參訓。
facts.en: Mid-term plan S1: Gold Touch Butler Hospitality Training ran 10 cohorts with 234 participants from 112-2 to 114-1.

facts.zh: 訓練內容：儀態、儀容、站姿與應對禮儀；貴賓接待、客房整理與服務情境演練，由業界講師現場示範（如毛巾摺疊實作）。
facts.en: Training content: deportment, grooming, posture and etiquette; VIP reception, room preparation and service role-plays, demonstrated on site by industry trainers (e.g. towel folding).

facts.zh: 相關課程：系訂選修列有「管家服務」與「服務中心作業實務」等課程，可與管家培訓相互銜接。
facts.en: Related courses: department electives such as Butler Service and Concierge Operation connect with the butler training.

plain.zh: 中程發展計畫 S1「Gold Touch 金鑰匙管家款待服務培訓」112-2 至 114-1 學期共 10 梯次、234 人次，內容涵蓋儀態、儀容、站姿與應對禮儀，以及貴賓接待、客房整理與服務情境演練。
plain.en: Mid-term plan S1 Gold Touch Butler Hospitality Training ran 10 cohorts (234 participants) from 112-2 to 114-1, covering deportment, grooming, posture and etiquette, VIP reception, room preparation and service role-plays.

name.zh: 實習旅館神秘客培訓與品質檢核
name.en: Mystery Guest Training & Service Quality Audit

who.zh: 群賢會館 × 中程發展計畫 S3

facts.zh: 中程發展計畫 S3「實習旅館神秘客培訓與反饋」：學生經課堂培訓、評分工具說明與儀器操作演練後，以神秘客角色檢核客房品質。
facts.en: Mid-term plan S3 'Practicum Hotel Mystery Guest Training and Feedback': after classroom training, scoring-tool briefings and instrument practice, students check room quality as mystery guests.

facts.zh: 四班輪流試住：由四個班級輪流試住群賢會館評分，回收評分表 92 份（目標 70 份）、提出改善建議 52 項（目標 30 項）。
facts.en: Four classes take turns staying at Elite House: 92 scoring sheets collected (target 70) and 52 improvement suggestions made (target 30).

facts.zh: 回饋改善：硬體 22 項已逐項改善或修復；服務 30 項納入課程教材，列為下學期校內實習改善重點。
facts.en: Follow-up: 22 hardware items were fixed one by one; 30 service items were added to course materials as priorities for the next semester's on-campus practicum.

plain.zh: 中程發展計畫 S3「實習旅館神秘客培訓與反饋」由四班輪流試住群賢會館，回收評分表 92 份、提出改善建議 52 項（硬體 22 項、服務 30 項），硬體逐項修復、服務建議納入教材與校內實習改善重點。
plain.en: Under mid-term plan S3, four classes took turns staying at Elite House as mystery guests, returning 92 scoring sheets and 52 suggestions (22 hardware, 30 service); hardware issues were fixed and service suggestions became teaching material and practicum priorities.

name.zh: 國際奢華酒店企業學苑與育才扎根
name.en: Luxury Hotel Corporate Academy & Talent Programme

who.zh: 旅館管理系 × 國際頂奢酒店集團
who.en: Dept. of Hotel Management × Global Luxury Hotel Groups

facts.zh: 國際奢華旅館育才扎根：113.1 與台北文華東方酒店、台北 W 飯店簽訂育才扎根計畫，113.6 臺北嘉佩樂酒店加入，發展為國際奢華酒店企業學苑專班。
facts.en: Luxury hotel talent programme: signed with Mandarin Oriental Taipei and W Taipei in Jan 2024 and joined by Capella Taipei in Jun 2024, developing into the luxury hotel corporate academy class.

facts.zh: 四年職涯培育路徑：大一大二職涯探索與品牌說明會、大三一年校外實習跨部門輪調、大四潛力學生銜接儲備主管培訓，畢業儲備幹部直通月薪 4 萬元以上。
facts.en: Four-year career pathway: career exploration and brand sessions in Years 1–2, a year-long internship with cross-department rotation in Year 3, management-trainee preparation in Year 4, and a management-trainee track starting at NT$40,000+ per month.

facts.zh: 雇主評價：雇主整體滿意度 4.33 分（滿分 5 分，112 年調查），評價最高為學習能力及意願（4.41）、工作態度（4.37）與知識技能（4.36）。
facts.en: Employer view: overall employer satisfaction 4.33/5 (2023 survey), highest for willingness to learn (4.41), work attitude (4.37) and knowledge and skills (4.36).

plain.zh: 113 學年國際奢華酒店企業學苑專班的學生回饋與業界檢討，轉化為 8 門奢華體驗管理微學分，補足品牌文化、服務哲學與高端顧客關係管理，核心是顧客體驗設計與情緒價值創造。
plain.en: Student feedback and industry review of the AY 113 luxury hotel corporate academy class were turned into 8 Luxury Experience Management micro-credits covering brand culture, service philosophy and high-end guest relationships, centred on customer experience design and emotional value creation.

referenceSummary.en: Anchoring the 'Smart Hotel Tech × Luxury Experience Management' dual axis: the luxury hotel corporate academy class evolved into 8 Luxury Experience Management micro-credits (AY 113-2 to 114-2, all approved through three-level review), alongside S1 Gold Touch butler training and S3 Mystery Guest training at Elite House

name.zh: 數位智慧服務與創新基地

summary.zh: D 棟 8 樓「餐旅數位智慧服務與創新基地」於 114 年 3 月揭牌，設有 D803 數位轉型教室、D807 專業階梯教室、D808 智能服務中心與 D812 多功能教室，配置 AI 語音助理、服務型機器人、TMS 任務管理、智慧門鎖與清潔機器人，並與「國際奢華旅館智能科技服務共創聯盟」科技夥伴合作
summary.en: The Hospitality Digital Smart Service & Innovation Base on the 8th floor of Building D opened in March 2025, with D803 Digital Transformation Classroom, D807 lecture theatre, D808 Smart Service Lab and D812 multi-purpose classroom, equipped with AI voice assistants, service robots, TMS, smart locks and cleaning robots, and working with the partners of the Luxury Hotel Smart Tech Co-Creation Alliance

name.zh: D 棟 8 樓「餐旅數位智慧服務與創新基地」
name.en: Bldg. D 8F Digital Smart Service & Innovation Base

who.zh: D 棟 8 樓・114 年 3 月揭牌

facts.zh: 114 年 3 月揭牌：D 棟 8 樓「餐旅數位智慧服務與創新基地」為本系智慧旅館科技軸的發展節點（教育部紫領計畫 → 智能服務中心 → 群賢智慧客房 → 數位服務與創新基地）。
facts.en: Opened March 2025: the base on Building D 8F is a milestone of the Smart Hotel Tech axis (MOE Purple-Collar Project → Smart Service Lab → Qunxian smart rooms → Digital Service & Innovation Base).

facts.zh: 空間配置：D803 數位轉型教室（40 人）、D807 專業階梯教室（165 人）、D808 智能服務中心、D812 多功能教室（餐飲、客務、房務）。
facts.en: Spaces: D803 Digital Transformation Classroom (40 seats), D807 lecture theatre (165 seats), D808 Smart Service Lab, D812 multi-purpose classroom (F&B, front office, housekeeping).

facts.zh: 智慧設備：AI 語音助理、服務型機器人、TMS 任務管理、智慧門鎖與清潔機器人，支援智慧旅宿實作教學。
facts.en: Smart equipment: AI voice assistants, service robots, TMS task management, smart locks and cleaning robots for hands-on smart-hotel teaching.

plain.zh: D 棟 8 樓「餐旅數位智慧服務與創新基地」於 114 年 3 月揭牌，整合 D808 智能服務中心、D803 數位轉型教室等空間與 AI 語音助理、服務型機器人、TMS 任務管理、智慧門鎖、清潔機器人等智慧設備。
plain.en: The Hospitality Digital Smart Service & Innovation Base on Building D 8F opened in March 2025, combining the D808 Smart Service Lab, the D803 Digital Transformation Classroom and other rooms with AI voice assistants, service robots, TMS, smart locks and cleaning robots.

name.zh: AIoT 智慧客房與服務型機器人協作
name.en: AIoT Smart Guestroom & Service Robot Collaboration

who.zh: 旅館管理系・智慧旅館科技軸線
who.en: Dept. of Hotel Management · Smart Hotel Tech Axis

facts.zh: 群賢智慧客房：群賢會館 108 年配合教育部紫領計畫以 AIoT 智慧旅宿重新修繕，共 12 間客房。
facts.en: Qunxian smart rooms: Elite House was renovated as an AIoT smart hotel in 2019 under the MOE Purple-Collar Project and has 12 guestrooms.

facts.zh: 服務型機器人：系訂選修「餐旅自動化機器人應用實務」讓學生實際操作服務型機器人，學習人機協作的服務流程。
facts.en: Service robots: the elective Hospitality Robots Practical Applications lets students operate service robots and learn human–robot service workflows.

facts.zh: 智慧設備實作：AI 語音助理、TMS 任務管理、智慧門鎖與清潔機器人等設備，讓學生體驗智慧旅宿營運。
facts.en: Smart equipment practice: AI voice assistants, TMS task management, smart locks and cleaning robots give students hands-on smart-hotel operations.

plain.zh: 從 108 年紫領計畫的機器人示範場域與群賢智慧客房，到「餐旅自動化機器人應用實務」課程，學生實際操作服務型機器人與 AI 語音助理、智慧門鎖等設備。
plain.en: From the 2019 Purple-Collar robot demonstration site and the Qunxian smart rooms to the Hospitality Robots Practical Applications course, students operate service robots, AI voice assistants and smart locks.

name.zh: 國際奢華旅館智能科技服務共創聯盟
name.en: International Luxury Hotel Smart Tech Co-Creation Alliance

who.zh: 旅館管理系 × 智慧旅宿科技夥伴
who.en: Dept. of Hotel Management × Smart Hospitality Tech Partners

facts.zh: 113.4.10 簽署「國際奢華旅館智能科技服務共創聯盟」合作備忘錄。
facts.en: Signed the Luxury Hotel Smart Tech Service Co-Creation Alliance memorandum on 10 Apr 2024.

facts.zh: 科技夥伴：犀動智能、緯創數技、季河資訊、德安資訊、資策會、微軟、AWS 與 Oracle。
facts.en: Technology partners: Aiello, Wistron Digital Technology, Ji-He Information, De-An Information, III, Microsoft, AWS and Oracle.

facts.zh: 資源導入：合作夥伴資源導入課程、實習、職涯與智慧教學，再由產業回饋修正課程。
facts.en: Resources: partner resources feed into courses, internships, careers and smart teaching, and industry feedback shapes the curriculum.

plain.zh: 本系於 113.4.10 簽署「國際奢華旅館智能科技服務共創聯盟」合作備忘錄，與犀動智能、緯創數技、季河資訊、德安資訊、資策會、微軟、AWS、Oracle 等科技夥伴合作，將資源導入課程、實習、職涯與智慧教學。
plain.en: On 10 Apr 2024 the department signed the Luxury Hotel Smart Tech Service Co-Creation Alliance memorandum, working with technology partners such as Aiello, Wistron Digital Technology, Ji-He Information, De-An Information, III, Microsoft, AWS and Oracle to bring resources into courses, internships, careers and smart teaching.

name.zh: OPERA PMS 實戰研習與 AI 雙軌認證
name.en: OPERA PMS Bootcamp & AI Dual-Track Certification

who.zh: 旅館管理系・1+3 數位與資訊證照輔導
who.en: Dept. of Hotel Management · 1+3 Digital & IT Certification

facts.zh: OPERA 系列研習：資產系統導論、實戰基礎、實戰進階，由業界主管授課、本系核發結業證書；系訂必修「旅館資產管理系統與操作實務」整合 OPERA 與德安系統。
facts.en: OPERA workshop series: introduction, fundamentals and advanced practice, taught by industry managers with department certificates of completion; the required course Hotel Property Management System and Operation covers OPERA and De-An.

facts.zh: 對接 1+3 畢業門檻：B 類證照含 AI-900（Microsoft Azure AI Fundamentals）、PL-900、Google Analytics Certification 與 LINE 官方帳號專家認證；C 類（1 張抵 2 張 B 類）含 AWS Certified AI Practitioner 與 PL-300 Microsoft Power BI Data Analyst。
facts.en: Linked to the 1+3 graduation rule: Category B includes AI-900 (Microsoft Azure AI Fundamentals), PL-900, Google Analytics Certification and LINE Official Account Expert; Category C (1 C = 2 B) includes AWS Certified AI Practitioner and PL-300 Microsoft Power BI Data Analyst.

facts.zh: 考照輔導成果：114-1 學期開設 CHDT、LINE 官方數位行銷與 GA 等 4 門 6 班考照班，通過 169 人，參加考照班之學員全數通過。
facts.en: Exam prep results: in 114-1, 4 courses in 6 classes (CHDT, LINE official digital marketing, GA) saw 169 students pass; every participant passed.

plain.zh: 推動 OPERA 研習結業證書與 Azure AI-900、AWS Certified AI Practitioner 雙軌認證，並對接 1+3 畢業條件 B／C 類資訊證照。
plain.en: Dual-track certification: OPERA workshop certificates plus Azure AI-900 and AWS Certified AI Practitioner, linked to the Category B/C IT certificates of the 1+3 graduation rule.

referenceSummary.zh: D 棟 8 樓「餐旅數位智慧服務與創新基地」於 114 年 3 月揭牌，設有 D803 數位轉型教室、D807 專業階梯教室、D808 智能服務中心與 D812 多功能教室，配置 AI 語音助理、服務型機器人、TMS 任務管理、智慧門鎖與清潔機器人，並與「國際奢華旅館智能科技服務共創聯盟」科技夥伴合作
referenceSummary.en: The Hospitality Digital Smart Service & Innovation Base on the 8th floor of Building D opened in March 2025, with D803 Digital Transformation Classroom, D807 lecture theatre, D808 Smart Service Lab and D812 multi-purpose classroom, equipped with AI voice assistants, service robots, TMS, smart locks and cleaning robots, and working with the partners of the Luxury Hotel Smart Tech Co-Creation Alliance

vision.zh: D 棟 8 樓「餐旅數位智慧服務與創新基地」於 114 年 3 月揭牌，設有 D803 數位轉型教室、D807 專業階梯教室、D808 智能服務中心與 D812 多功能教室，配置 AI 語音助理、服務型機器人、TMS 任務管理、智慧門鎖與清潔機器人，並與「國際奢華旅館智能科技服務共創聯盟」科技夥伴合作
vision.en: The Hospitality Digital Smart Service & Innovation Base on the 8th floor of Building D opened in March 2025, with D803 Digital Transformation Classroom, D807 lecture theatre, D808 Smart Service Lab and D812 multi-purpose classroom, equipped with AI voice assistants, service robots, TMS, smart locks and cleaning robots, and working with the partners of the Luxury Hotel Smart Tech Co-Creation Alliance

name.zh: 永續旅宿治理、研發與 USR

summary.zh: 結合「智慧餐旅永續營運治理」課程（ISO 14064 等永續治理）、企業 ISO 14064 溫室氣體盤查產學案、教師主持之國科會計畫、交通部觀光局（現觀光署）委託「星級旅館評鑑制度革新之研究」，以及金山、龍目、華山國小陪伴服務
summary.en: Combining the Smart Hospitality for Sustainable Governance course (ISO 14064 and other standards), an ISO 14064 greenhouse-gas inventory industry project, faculty-led NSTC research, the Tourism Bureau (now Tourism Administration) commissioned study on reforming the star-hotel rating system, and companionship programmes at Jinshan, Longmu and Huashan elementary schools

name.zh: 智慧餐旅永續營運治理（ISO 14064・14067・50001）

who.zh: 旅館管理系・永續旅宿與減碳專業
who.en: Dept. of Hotel Management · Sustainable Hospitality & Net-Zero

facts.zh: 課程導入國際永續標準：系訂選修「智慧餐旅永續營運治理」（2 學分）涵蓋 ISO 14064、ISO 14067 與 ISO 50001 等永續治理內容。
facts.en: International sustainability standards in class: the 2-credit elective Smart Hospitality for Sustainable Governance covers ISO 14064, ISO 14067 and ISO 50001.

facts.zh: 產學實作：本系承接企業「ISO 14064 溫室氣體盤查服務」產學合作案，並由許孟鈞老師主持國科會 113 年「旅館綠色轉型ESG勢在必行、數位科技革新碳盤無所遁形－旅館綠色人才ESG素養加值教學發展模式」研究計畫。
facts.en: Industry practice: the department carried out an ISO 14064 greenhouse-gas inventory service project for a company, and a faculty member leads the NSTC project on ESG literacy teaching for green hotel talent.

facts.zh: 永續講座與觀摩：中程計畫 S8 辦理永續知能講座與旅館產業共創永續活動，並至雲品、綠生農場、笠復威斯汀、豐邑喜來登永續觀摩。
facts.en: Talks and visits: mid-term plan S8 runs sustainability talks and co-creation activities with hotels, with sustainability visits to Fleur de Chine, Lusheng Farm, The Westin Tashee and Sheraton Hsinchu.

plain.zh: 對應中程發展計畫 S8 與資訊科技類課程智慧化發展，開設「智慧餐旅永續營運治理」課程（ISO 14064 等永續治理），並以企業 ISO 14064 溫室氣體盤查產學案連結實務。
plain.en: In line with mid-term plan S8 and the smart IT curriculum, the department offers Smart Hospitality for Sustainable Governance (ISO 14064 and related standards) and links it to practice through an ISO 14064 greenhouse-gas inventory industry project.

name.zh: 教師學術研發與國科會計畫

who.zh: 旅館管理系・專任教師學術研發能量
who.en: Dept. of Hotel Management · Faculty Research Excellence

facts.zh: 國科會計畫：許孟鈞老師主持國科會 114–115 年多年期計畫「基於小語言模型(SLM)與檢索增強生成(RAG)的服務溫度感知對話式餐旅機器人：跨世代生成式AI素養教學模式的實證研究」，以及 113 年「旅館綠色轉型ESG勢在必行、數位科技革新碳盤無所遁形－旅館綠色人才ESG素養加值教學發展模式」、112 年「餐旅智慧應用即服務產業創新採用之研究」等計畫（資料來源：政府研究資訊系統 GRB）。
facts.en: NSTC projects: Dr. Meng-Jun Hsu leads a 2025–2026 multi-year NSTC project on SLM & RAG conversational hospitality robots for cross-generational generative-AI literacy, plus 2024 (ESG literacy teaching for green hotel talent) and 2023 (Hospitality-as-a-Service adoption) projects (source: GRB).

facts.zh: 跨所合作與政府委託：謝金龍老師為國科會 112–113 年「餐旅業之台式殷勤款待服務資本：概念化、衡量與實證應用」及 115 年「智慧旅宿服務載具應用於AIoT備品巡檢及智能客服示範計畫」共同主持人；沙荃老師主持交通部觀光局（現觀光署）委託「星級旅館評鑑制度革新之研究」（108–110 年）。
facts.en: Cross-unit and government work: Asst. Prof. Chin-Lung Hsieh co-leads the 2023–2024 NSTC project on Taiwanese hospitality service capital and the 2026 AIoT smart-hotel demonstration project; Dr. Roger Sha led the Tourism Bureau (now Tourism Administration) commissioned study on reforming the star-hotel rating system (2019–2021).

facts.zh: 全球前 2% 科學家：楊仁德教授曾入選 Elsevier／史丹佛「全球前 2% 科學家」2021、2022、2023 年發布之單年度榜（資料集 v3、v5、v6）；2024 年以後的版本本系無教師入選。
facts.en: World's Top 2% Scientists: Prof. Jen-Te Yang was listed in the single-year 'World's Top 2% Scientists' lists (Elsevier/Stanford) released in 2021, 2022 and 2023 (dataset v3, v5, v6); no department faculty appear in the 2024 and later releases.

plain.zh: 國科會計畫：許孟鈞老師主持國科會 114–115 年多年期計畫「基於小語言模型(SLM)與檢索增強生成(RAG)的服務溫度感知對話式餐旅機器人：跨世代生成式AI素養教學模式的實證研究」，以及 113 年「旅館綠色轉型ESG勢在必行、數位科技革新碳盤無所遁形－旅館綠色人才ESG素養加值教學發展模式」、112 年「餐旅智慧應用即服務產業創新採用之研究」等計畫（資料來源：政府研究資訊系統 GRB）。
plain.en: NSTC projects: Dr. Meng-Jun Hsu leads a 2025–2026 multi-year NSTC project on SLM & RAG conversational hospitality robots for cross-generational generative-AI literacy, plus 2024 (ESG literacy teaching for green hotel talent) and 2023 (Hospitality-as-a-Service adoption) projects (source: GRB).

name.zh: 星級旅館評鑑制度革新研究與教師專業服務
name.en: Star-Hotel Rating Reform Study & Faculty Professional Service

who.zh: 旅館管理系 × 交通部觀光局（現觀光署）委託研究
who.en: Dept. of Hotel Management × Tourism Bureau (now Tourism Administration) Study

facts.zh: 政府委託研究：沙荃老師主持交通部觀光局（現觀光署）委託「星級旅館評鑑制度革新之研究」（108–110 年），讓教師直接參與產業標準的制定。
facts.en: Government study: a faculty member led the Tourism Bureau (now Tourism Administration) commissioned study on reforming the star-hotel rating system (2019–2021), involving faculty directly in industry standards.

facts.zh: 競賽裁判與審查：教師擔任全國與亞洲技能競賽旅館接待職類裁判長、技術顧問，以及評選委員、教學實踐研究計畫審查委員。
facts.en: Judging and review: faculty serve as chief judges and technical advisers for Hotel Reception at the national and Asian skills competitions, as selection committee members and as Teaching Practice Research reviewers.

facts.zh: 學術與產業服務：112–114 學年學術專業服務 22 件（SSCI 期刊審稿、Guest Editor、學位考試委員等）、產業交流與專業服務 31 件。
facts.en: Academic and industry service in AY 112–114: 22 academic services (SSCI journal reviewing, guest editing, degree examination committees) and 31 industry exchange and professional services.

plain.zh: 本系教師主持交通部觀光局（現觀光署）委託「星級旅館評鑑制度革新之研究」，並擔任全國與亞洲技能競賽旅館接待職類裁判長、評選委員與教學實踐研究計畫審查委員。
plain.en: Faculty led the Tourism Bureau (now Tourism Administration) commissioned study on reforming the star-hotel rating system and serve as Hotel Reception chief judges at national and Asian skills competitions, selection committee members and Teaching Practice Research reviewers.

name.en: USR Local Elementary Outreach & Sustainable Hotel Tours

who.zh: 旅館管理系系學會 × USR 大學社會責任
who.en: HTL Student Association × University Social Responsibility (USR)

facts.zh: 國小陪伴活動：學生前往金山、龍目、華山國小辦理陪伴活動，分別有 70、51、40 人次參與。
facts.en: Elementary school companionship: students ran programmes at Jinshan, Longmu and Huashan elementary schools with 70, 51 and 40 participations respectively.

facts.zh: 品德與公民素養：師生座談除大三實習期間外每學期至少一次（出席率約九成），並有薪火相傳經驗分享與新生職涯講座。
facts.en: Character and civic education: faculty–student forums at least once a semester except during the Junior internship (about 90% attendance), plus 'Passing the Torch' sharing and freshman career talks.

facts.zh: 永續觀摩：至雲品、綠生農場、笠復威斯汀、豐邑喜來登進行永續觀摩，並辦理中程計畫 S8 永續知能講座。
facts.en: Sustainability visits: Fleur de Chine, Lusheng Farm, The Westin Tashee and Sheraton Hsinchu, plus S8 sustainability talks.

plain.zh: 本系把品德與公民素養放在真實情境中培養：金山、龍目、華山國小陪伴活動分別有 70、51、40 人次參與，並至雲品、綠生農場、笠復威斯汀、豐邑喜來登永續觀摩。
plain.en: Character and civic education in real settings: companionship programmes at Jinshan, Longmu and Huashan elementary schools (70, 51 and 40 participations), and sustainability visits to Fleur de Chine, Lusheng Farm, The Westin Tashee and Sheraton Hsinchu.

text.zh: 系主任負責推動系行政業務，串連課程、實習、師資與規章各主題
text.en: The department chair leads administration, linking curriculum, internships, faculty and regulations

text.zh: 系務會議、教學研討會與導師會議，使系務運作制度化與合理化
text.en: Department meetings, teaching seminars and mentor meetings institutionalize department operations

text.zh: 教學理念：開設實用課程並延攬具有實務經驗之優良師資
text.en: Teaching philosophy: offer practical courses and recruit faculty with industry experience

text.zh: 教學措施遵照教育部規程，並依本系特殊屬性擬定教學工作計畫
text.en: Teaching follows Ministry of Education rules and plans tailored to the department

text.zh: 課程規劃鼓勵海外實習；優先選才含國(海)外實習及研習
text.en: The curriculum plan encourages overseas internships; priority selection includes overseas internships and study

text.zh: 課程標準表列有海外參訪(一)(二)，修讀(二)須先修畢(一)
text.en: The curriculum lists Field Study I and II; Field Study II requires Field Study I

text.zh: 第三學年校外實習(一)(二)，銜接實習旅館專島 24 家菁英實習合作旅館
text.en: Year-3 Internship I and II connect directly to all 24 Elite Internship partner hotels on the Internship Hotels Island

text.zh: 教師定期赴學生實習場所訪視，並與旅館業界保持密切連繫
text.en: Faculty regularly visit internship sites and keep close contact with the hotel industry

text.zh: 行政組員辦理畢業專業條件等課務業務，支援1+3畢業條件
text.en: Administrative staff handle graduation-requirement course affairs, supporting the 1+3 rule

text.zh: 群賢會館供示範模擬教學與實務，對應課程中的校內實習
text.en: Elite House supports demonstration teaching and practice, matching on-campus internship courses

text.zh: 行政組員協辦群賢會館營運行政庶務，並負責課程協調與排課
text.en: Staff assist Elite House administration and handle course coordination and scheduling

text.zh: 系務指導系學會社團活動，並安排校外參觀與專題演講
text.en: The department guides student association activities and arranges visits and talks

text.zh: 旅館菁英實習計畫3.0實施方式列於本系相關法規
text.en: The Elite Internship Program 3.0 rules are listed among department regulations

text.zh: 餐飲服務丙級技術士列B類證照，配套措施對應「餐飲實務」必修課
text.en: The F&B service technician (Level C) is a Category B certificate; the backup measure maps to the required F&B Service course

text.zh: 海外參訪與餐旅專題講座，呼應教材教學輔以講座及校外參訪
text.en: Field studies and hospitality seminars reflect teaching supplemented by lectures and visits

text.zh: 國際禮儀列於系訂選修，亦為專任教師專長之一
text.en: International Etiquette is a department elective and a faculty specialty

text.zh: 旅館英文(一)與旅館日文(一)(二)列於系訂必修
text.en: Hotel English I and Hotel Japanese I–II are department-required courses

text.zh: A類外語檢定標準相當於TOEIC 600分(含)以上，列入1+3畢業條件
text.en: Category A language standard is TOEIC 600 or above, part of the 1+3 rule

text.zh: 本系介紹之課程規劃，明列推動精進外語能力
text.en: The curriculum plan in the dept. introduction promotes better foreign-language skills

text.zh: 跨文化服務與管理、海外參訪(一)(二)皆列於系訂選修
text.en: Cross-cultural Service and Management and Field Study I–II are department electives

text.zh: 旅館管理系專業教室管理要點列於本系相關法規
text.en: The professional classroom management rules are listed among department regulations

text.zh: 專業教室配合教學方式：老師示範、學生親自操作
text.en: Professional classrooms support teacher demonstration and hands-on student practice

text.zh: 勞作教育為沿革所述新學制之一，落實校園環境清潔
text.en: Labor education, one of the new systems in the department history, keeps the campus clean

text.zh: 餐旅專題講座與餐旅資訊科技應用實務同列系訂必修
text.en: Hospitality Seminars and Hospitality IT Applications are both department-required

text.zh: 特色目標「熟悉現代旅館內之軟硬體」，對應旅館資訊管理系統
text.en: The goal of knowing modern hotel hardware and software matches the hotel information systems

text.zh: 本系介紹「特殊設備」列有 OPERA PMS 與德安資訊PMS
text.en: The dept. introduction's special equipment lists OPERA PMS and Dean PMS

text.zh: 旅館資產管理系統與操作實務列為系訂必修，納入四年課程
text.en: Hotel PMS and Operation is a department-required course in the four-year curriculum

text.zh: 旅館日文(一)(二)可依N3以上申請免修，學分須另行修習補足
text.en: Hotel Japanese I–II may be waived with JLPT N3+, with credits made up elsewhere

text.zh: 沿革載明九十六年招收四年制旅館管理系外籍－越南生專班
text.en: The history notes a four-year program for Vietnamese international students from 2007

text.zh: 發展特色以資訊科技、數位行銷與大數據分析能力培育旅館人才
text.en: The development features build IT, digital marketing and big-data skills for hotel careers

text.zh: 師資延攬於旅館飯店工作之優秀校友蒞校兼任授課
text.en: Outstanding alumni working in hotels are invited to teach part-time

text.zh: 系網活動含112學年度新生職涯講座，可對照就業與升學資訊
text.en: Department activities include the AY112 freshman career lecture, alongside career and study info

text.zh: 菁英實習前六個月於客房部；群賢會館供示範模擬教學與實務
text.en: Elite interns start six months in rooms division; Elite House supports demonstration and practice

text.zh: Gold Touch 金鑰匙管家培訓與 S3 神秘客試住檢核，以群賢會館為實作場域；8 門奢華體驗管理微學分補足品牌文化與服務哲學
